taxonomy.label: 模型与任务

subs.label: 大语言与多模态模型

subs.label: 预训练模型与经典 NLP

subs.label: 计算机视觉

subs.label: 语音识别
subs.def: 语音转文字模型、推理加速与听写工具（Whisper 系、DeepSpeech 一类）
subs.def_en: Speech-to-text models, inference accelerators, and dictation tools (Whisper family, DeepSpeech)

subs.label: 语音合成、声音转换与音频处理

subs.label: 图像与视频生成

subs.label: 图像增强与换脸

projects.name: openclaw/openclaw
projects.summary: 开源个人 AI 助理网关，跑在自己的电脑/服务器上，通过 Discord、iMessage、Slack、Teams、Telegram、WhatsApp 等 20+ 渠道聊天触达；模型与执行后端（Claude、Codex、本地模型）都是可替换插件，状态、记忆和密钥全部留在本地硬件，由独立的 OpenClaw 基金会（501c3）主导，无付费层、无托管服务。
projects.summary_en: Open-source personal AI assistant gateway that runs on your own computer or server and is reachable through 20+ channels including Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram, and WhatsApp. Models and execution backends (Claude, Codex, local models) are swappable plugins; state, memory, and keys stay on your own hardware. Led by the independent OpenClaw Foundation (501c3), with no paid tier and no hosted service.

projects.name: obra/superpowers
projects.summary: 面向编码 Agent 的完整软件开发方法论，由一组可组合的技能加初始指令构成，强制走“需求澄清→计划→TDD→子 Agent 驱动开发”的流程，支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini CLI 等十几种工具。
projects.summary_en: Complete software-development methodology for coding agents, made of composable skills plus initial instructions that force a "clarify requirements, plan, TDD, sub-agent-driven development" flow. Supports a dozen-plus tools including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI.

projects.name: mattpocock/skills
projects.summary: 作者本人日常工程实践中实际使用的 Agent 技能合集，刻意做得小、易改、可组合、不绑定具体模型；可作为 Claude Code 插件整体订阅，也可以用 skills.sh 把可编辑的技能文件拷进项目自行魔改。
projects.summary_en: The author's own everyday agent skills, deliberately small, editable, composable, and model-agnostic. Subscribe to the whole set as a Claude Code plugin, or copy editable skill files into a project with skills.sh and hack on them.

projects.name: affaan-m/ECC
projects.summary: 面向 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor 等工具的 Agent Harness 性能优化系统，打包了技能、直觉记忆、安全防护和研究优先的开发流程；仓库本身 MIT 免费，同时有收费的 ECC Pro 托管版和 GitHub App。
projects.summary_en: Performance-optimization system for agent harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Cursor, bundling skills, instinct memory, security guardrails, and a research-first development workflow. The repo itself is free under MIT; a paid hosted ECC Pro and a GitHub App also exist.

projects.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
projects.summary: Nous Research 出品的自我进化 Agent，内置学习闭环：从使用经验中生成技能、在使用中持续改进、主动沉淀知识并检索自己的历史对话；可跑在 5 美元 VPS、GPU 集群或按量计费的 serverless 上，支持 Telegram/Discord/Slack/WhatsApp/Signal/CLI 多入口，模型可在 Nous Portal、OpenRouter、OpenAI 等之间自由切换。
projects.summary_en: Self-evolving agent from Nous Research with a built-in learning loop: it generates skills from experience, keeps improving as it is used, proactively builds knowledge, and searches its own past conversations. Runs on a $5 VPS, a GPU cluster, or pay-as-you-go serverless, with multiple entry points (Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, CLI) and freely switchable models across Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI, and more.

projects.name: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
projects.summary: DeepSeek 官方开源的 Agent Harness（dsh），采用“一切皆插件”架构，底层基于 Cordis 框架构建；目前处于开发者预览阶段，API 会有破坏性变更，可通过 npx 直接启动带 Web UI 的本地服务。
projects.summary_en: DeepSeek's official open-source agent harness (dsh), built on an "everything is a plugin" architecture on top of the Cordis framework. In developer preview with breaking API changes expected; a local service with a web UI can be launched directly via npx.

projects.name: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills
projects.summary: 把 Andrej Karpathy 关于 LLM 编码毛病的一条推文（乱假设不澄清、过度设计、动不必要的代码/注释）提炼成四条原则，做成单个 CLAUDE.md 文件，直接合并进项目即可改善 Claude Code 的行为。
projects.summary_en: Distills a tweet by Andrej Karpathy about LLM coding faults (wrong assumptions without asking, over-engineering, touching unnecessary code and comments) into four principles in a single CLAUDE.md file that you merge into a project to improve Claude Code's behavior.

projects.name: anomalyco/opencode
projects.summary: 开源编码 Agent，提供跨平台命令行界面和处于 Beta 阶段的桌面应用，支持 npm/brew/scoop/choco/pacman/nix 等多种方式安装，覆盖 20+ 语言的本地化文档。
projects.summary_en: Open-source coding agent with a cross-platform CLI and a beta desktop app. Installable via npm, brew, scoop, choco, pacman, nix, and more, with localized docs in 20+ languages.

projects.name: n8n-io/n8n
projects.summary: Fair-code 协议的工作流自动化平台，原本是通用集成工具，现在把 AI 原生能力做进核心：可视化画布加自定义代码搭建多步 Agent 工作流，接入 OpenAI/Anthropic/Google 等任意模型且不锁定供应商，自带 1500+ 集成和 9000+ 模板。
projects.summary_en: Fair-code workflow-automation platform that started as a general integration tool and now builds AI natively into its core: a visual canvas plus custom code for multi-step agent workflows, works with any model (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more) without vendor lock-in, and ships with 1,500+ integrations and 9,000+ templates.

projects.name: tensorflow/tensorflow
projects.summary: Google 开源的端到端机器学习平台，提供 Python / C++ 的张量计算、自动微分、模型训练与部署工具链，覆盖服务器、移动端与浏览器。
projects.summary_en: Google's open-source end-to-end machine learning platform, with tensor computation, autodiff, and a training-to-deployment toolchain spanning servers, mobile, and the browser.

projects.name: microsoft/markitdown
projects.summary: Microsoft 官方出品的轻量 Python 工具，把 PDF、PPT、Word、Excel、图片（含 OCR）、音频等各类文件转换成 Markdown，专为 LLM 和文本分析流水线设计，优先保留标题、列表、表格、链接等文档结构而非追求给人看的高保真排版。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's lightweight Python tool that converts PDF, PPT, Word, Excel, images (with OCR), audio, and other files to Markdown, built for LLM and text-analysis pipelines. Prioritizes preserving structure such as headings, lists, tables, and links over human-facing high-fidelity layout.

projects.name: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT
projects.summary: 开源 AI Agent 平台，用自然语言描述目标或在可视化编排器里逐步搭建，即可构建、部署、按需/定时/触发运行完整工作流；提供 AutoPilot、Agent 监控台、Marketplace 现成模板和可视化 Builder 四类入口。
projects.summary_en: Open-source AI agent platform: describe a goal in natural language or build step by step in a visual orchestrator to create, deploy, and run complete workflows on demand, on a schedule, or by trigger. Four entry points: AutoPilot, an agent monitoring console, a Marketplace of ready-made templates, and a visual Builder.

projects.name: firecrawl/firecrawl
projects.summary: 面向 Agent 的网页抓取 API，能搜索、抓取并与网页交互，把内容转成干净的 Markdown 或结构化 JSON；号称覆盖 96% 的网页（含 JS 重度渲染页面）、P95 延迟 3.4 秒，自动处理代理轮换、限流和反爬，也提供开源自建和托管两种形态。
projects.summary_en: Web-scraping API for agents that can search, scrape, and interact with pages, converting content into clean Markdown or structured JSON. Claims 96% web coverage (including JS-heavy pages) and a 3.4 s P95 latency, handles proxy rotation, rate limits, and anti-bot automatically, and comes both open-source self-hosted and as a hosted service.

projects.name: ollama/ollama
projects.summary: 本地运行大模型的命令行工具，一条命令即可下载并跑起 Kimi、GLM、MiniMax、DeepSeek、gpt-oss、Qwen、Gemma 等主流开源模型，并能直接接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw、OpenCode、Codex、Copilot 等编码 Agent。
projects.summary_en: Command-line tool for running LLMs locally: one command downloads and runs leading open models such as Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, and Gemma, and plugs directly into coding agents such as Claude Code, OpenClaw, OpenCode, Codex, and Copilot.

projects.name: anthropics/skills
projects.summary: Anthropic 官方的 Agent Skills 参考实现仓库，Skills 是 Claude 动态加载的一组指令、脚本和资源文件夹，用于在特定任务上教会 Claude 可复用的做法，涵盖品牌文档生成、企业专属数据分析工作流、个人任务自动化等场景。
projects.summary_en: Anthropic's official reference implementation for Agent Skills. Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads dynamically to learn repeatable ways of doing specific tasks, covering brand-compliant document generation, enterprise-specific data analysis workflows, personal task automation, and more.

projects.name: f/prompts.chat
projects.summary: 前身是 Awesome ChatGPT Prompts，现已发展成最大的开源 AI Prompt 库网站，收录的提示词同时适配 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Llama、Mistral 等主流模型，支持自行部署到公司内网使用。
projects.summary_en: Formerly Awesome ChatGPT Prompts, now the largest open-source AI prompt library site. Prompts work across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, and more, and it can be self-hosted inside a company network.

projects.name: huggingface/transformers
projects.summary: Hugging Face 官方出品，定位为“模型定义框架”：把文本、视觉、音频、多模态的前沿模型定义统一沉淀在一处，让同一个模型定义能被 Axolotl/DeepSpeed 等训练框架和 vLLM/SGLang/llama.cpp 等推理引擎直接复用，Hub 上已有 100 万+ 基于它的模型 checkpoint。
projects.summary_en: Hugging Face's "model-definition framework": frontier text, vision, audio, and multimodal model definitions live in one place, reusable directly by training frameworks like Axolotl and DeepSpeed and inference engines like vLLM, SGLang, and llama.cpp. Over 1 million model checkpoints on the Hub are built on it.

projects.name: AUTOMATIC1111/stable-diffusion-webui
projects.summary: 基于 Gradio 的 Stable Diffusion 网页界面，提供文生图、图生图、局部重绘、放大、LoRA 与大量社区扩展，是本地跑扩散模型最常用的前端之一。
projects.summary_en: A Gradio-based web UI for Stable Diffusion with txt2img, img2img, inpainting, upscaling, LoRA support, and a large extension ecosystem; one of the most widely used front ends for running diffusion models locally.

projects.name: langgenius/dify
projects.summary: 开源 LLM 应用开发平台，把 Agentic 工作流、RAG 管道、模型管理和可观测性（集成 Opik/Langfuse/Arize）整合进一个协作工作区，支持云端、VPC、自托管三种部署方式，帮助团队从原型直接走到生产。
projects.summary_en: Open-source LLM app development platform that brings agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, model management, and observability (integrating Opik/Langfuse/Arize) into one collaborative workspace. Deploys in the cloud, in a VPC, or self-hosted, taking teams from prototype straight to production.

projects.name: msitarzewski/agency-agents
projects.summary: 源自一个 Reddit 帖子、持续迭代打磨的“人格化”专家 Agent 角色合集，每个角色有独立性格、工作流程和交付标准，可安装进 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini 等工具；也有配套的跨平台桌面 App 一键浏览安装。
projects.summary_en: Collection of "personified" specialist agent roles that grew out of a Reddit post and keeps being refined. Each role has its own personality, workflow, and deliverable standards, and can be installed into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, and more; a companion cross-platform desktop app offers one-click browsing and install.

projects.name: langflow-ai/langflow
projects.summary: 可视化搭建和部署 AI Agent 工作流的平台，内置 API 和 MCP server，任何流程都能变成可被其他应用调用的工具；支持多 Agent 编排、LangSmith/LangFuse 可观测性，也提供开箱即用的 Langflow Desktop 桌面版。
projects.summary_en: Platform for visually building and deploying AI agent workflows, with a built-in API and MCP server so any flow can become a tool other apps call. Supports multi-agent orchestration and LangSmith/LangFuse observability, and offers a ready-to-use Langflow Desktop app.

projects.name: open-webui/open-webui
projects.summary: 可自托管、可完全离线运行的 AI 交互界面，同时支持 Ollama 和 OpenAI 兼容 API，能接入 LMStudio、GroqCloud、Mistral、OpenRouter 等任意提供商，通过 pip/uv/Docker/Kubernetes 都能一键部署。
projects.summary_en: Self-hostable AI interface that can run fully offline. Supports Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs and works with any provider (LMStudio, GroqCloud, Mistral, OpenRouter, and more), deployable in one step via pip, uv, Docker, or Kubernetes.

projects.name: DietrichGebert/ponytail
projects.summary: 一个让编码 Agent“少写代码”的技能：在真实 Claude Code 会话（FastAPI+React 仓库）上实测，平均减少约 54% 代码量、约 20% 花费和 27% 耗时，在 Agent 容易过度设计的场景（如日期选择器）最高减少 94%，同时保留必要的安全防护。
projects.summary_en: A skill that makes coding agents write less code. Measured on real Claude Code sessions (a FastAPI + React repo): about 54% less code, 20% lower cost, and 27% less time on average, up to 94% less where agents tend to over-engineer (such as date pickers), while keeping necessary safeguards.

projects.name: anthropics/claude-code
projects.summary: Anthropic 官方出品的终端 Agentic 编码工具，理解代码库上下文、执行常规任务、解释复杂代码、处理 git 工作流，全部通过自然语言完成；也可在 IDE 中使用，或在 GitHub 里 @claude 触发。
projects.summary_en: Anthropic's official agentic coding tool for the terminal. Understands your codebase, runs routine tasks, explains complex code, and handles git workflows, all through natural language. Also usable in IDEs or by @-mentioning claude on GitHub.

projects.name: langchain-ai/langchain
projects.summary: 定位为“Agent 工程平台”的框架，把可互操作的组件和第三方集成串联起来简化 LLM 应用开发；更高层的 Deep Agents 包提供规划、子 Agent、文件系统等内置能力，配套的 LangGraph 用于构建可控的 Agent 工作流编排。
projects.summary_en: Framework positioned as an "agent engineering platform" that chains interoperable components and third-party integrations to simplify LLM app development. The higher-level Deep Agents package adds planning, sub-agents, and a filesystem, and the companion LangGraph is used to build controllable agent workflows.

projects.name: x1xhlol/system-prompts-and-models-of-ai-tools
projects.summary: 收集 Cursor、Claude Code、Devin、v0、Windsurf、Replit、Lovable、Perplexity 等几十款主流 AI 产品泄露/提取出的完整系统提示词和内部工具定义，用于研究这些产品的真实 Prompt 工程做法，也提醒创业公司注意系统提示词泄露风险。
projects.summary_en: Collects complete leaked or extracted system prompts and internal tool definitions from dozens of mainstream AI products (Cursor, Claude Code, Devin, v0, Windsurf, Replit, Lovable, Perplexity, and more) to study their real prompt-engineering practice, and to warn startups about system-prompt leakage risks.

projects.name: Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps
projects.summary: 100 多个开源 AI Agent、Agent 技能和 RAG 应用的合集，全部端到端跑通、Apache-2.0 协议，覆盖保险理赔、诈骗调查、旅行规划等具体场景，可以直接 clone 跑起来或当作 Claude Code 技能一键安装。
projects.summary_en: Collection of 100+ open-source AI agents, agent skills, and RAG apps, all run end to end and Apache-2.0 licensed, covering concrete scenarios such as insurance claims, fraud investigation, and trip planning. Clone and run them directly, or install them as Claude Code skills in one step.

projects.name: github/spec-kit
projects.summary: GitHub 官方出品的规范驱动开发（SDD）工具包，给编码 Agent 提供结构化流程、可复用模板和留痕产出，覆盖建新功能、修 bug、评估想法三类独立场景，可自由组合或替换成自己的流程。
projects.summary_en: GitHub's spec-driven development (SDD) toolkit, giving coding agents a structured process, reusable templates, and traceable outputs. Covers three independent scenarios (new features, bug fixes, evaluating ideas) that can be combined or swapped for your own process.

projects.name: farion1231/cc-switch
projects.summary: 跨平台桌面一体化管理工具，一键切换 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Grok Build、OpenCode、OpenClaw、Hermes Agent 等编码 Agent 的 API 供应商，并统一管理 MCP、Skills 和 Prompt 配置，免去手改 JSON/TOML/YAML。
projects.summary_en: Cross-platform desktop manager that switches API providers for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and more) in one click and manages MCP, Skills, and prompt configs in one place, sparing you hand-edited JSON/TOML/YAML.

projects.name: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
projects.summary: 模块化的扩散模型图形界面与后端，用节点图串联采样、控制、放大等步骤，支持图像、视频和音频生成的可复用工作流。
projects.summary_en: A modular GUI and backend for diffusion models that chains sampling, control, and upscaling steps in a node graph, with reusable workflows for image, video, and audio generation.

projects.name: garrytan/gstack
projects.summary: Y Combinator 总裁 Garry Tan 公开的个人 Claude Code 配置，包含 23 个分饰 CEO、设计师、工程经理、发布经理、文档工程师、QA 等角色的定制工具，用于说明一个人如何靠 AI Agent 做到团队级产出。
projects.summary_en: Y Combinator president Garry Tan's public personal Claude Code setup, with 23 custom tools playing CEO, designer, engineering manager, release manager, docs engineer, QA, and other roles, showing how one person can deliver team-level output with AI agents.

projects.name: nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill
projects.summary: 为编码 Agent 提供 UI/UX 设计智能的技能，v2.0 核心功能是“设计系统生成器”：输入项目需求，AI 推理引擎几秒内生成一套完整、定制化的设计系统，兼容 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Copilot 等多个平台。
projects.summary_en: Skill that brings UI/UX design intelligence to coding agents. The core of v2.0 is a "design-system generator": describe your project and an AI reasoning engine produces a complete, tailored design system in seconds. Works across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, and more.

projects.name: ggml-org/llama.cpp
projects.summary: 用纯 C/C++ 实现的大模型推理引擎，基于自研的 ggml 张量库，几乎不依赖第三方库即可在 CPU/GPU/Apple Silicon 等各种硬件上跑量化后的 LLM，是本地部署生态里被最多上层工具（如 Ollama、LM Studio）复用的底层推理内核之一。
projects.summary_en: LLM inference engine in plain C/C++ built on its own ggml tensor library, with almost no third-party dependencies. Runs quantized LLMs on CPUs, GPUs, Apple Silicon, and more, and is one of the inference cores reused by the most higher-level local-deployment tools, such as Ollama and LM Studio.

projects.name: openai/codex
projects.summary: OpenAI 官方出品的轻量终端编码 Agent，可作为 CLI、IDE 插件（VS Code/Cursor/Windsurf）或桌面 App 使用，也有对应的云端版本 Codex Web。
projects.summary_en: OpenAI's lightweight terminal coding agent, usable as a CLI, IDE plugin (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf), or desktop app, with a cloud counterpart, Codex Web.

projects.name: harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo
projects.summary: 输入一个主题或关键词，自动生成视频脚本、匹配素材、生成字幕和背景音乐并合成高清短视频的一站式工具，支持接入 Kimi K3、DeepSeek 等大模型驱动文案与素材选择。
projects.summary_en: One-stop tool that turns a topic or keyword into a finished HD short video: it writes the script, matches footage, generates subtitles and background music, and composes the result. Can use LLMs such as Kimi K3 and DeepSeek to drive copy and footage selection.

projects.name: Graphify-Labs/graphify
projects.summary: 给编码 Agent 用的 /graphify 技能，把整个代码库连同文档、SQL schema、配置、PDF 一起解析成可查询的知识图谱；代码部分用 tree-sitter 做纯本地确定性 AST 解析、不接 LLM 也不用向量库，每条边都标注是“直接抽取”还是“推断得出”。
projects.summary_en: A /graphify skill for coding agents that parses a whole codebase together with docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs into a queryable knowledge graph. Code is parsed with purely local, deterministic tree-sitter ASTs, with no LLM and no vector store, and every edge is labeled as directly extracted or inferred.

projects.name: microsoft/generative-ai-for-beginners
projects.summary: Microsoft 官方出品的生成式 AI 入门课程，21 节课覆盖从基础概念到实际构建的完整路径，配套代码示例和多语言翻译（含简繁中文）。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's official generative-AI beginner course: 21 lessons covering the path from basic concepts to hands-on building, with code samples and multilingual translations (including Simplified and Traditional Chinese).

projects.name: VoltAgent/awesome-design-md
projects.summary: 知名品牌与开发者网站设计系统的 DESIGN.md 合集，复制到项目里即可让 AI Agent 生成风格一致的页面。
projects.summary_en: A collection of DESIGN.md analyses of popular brand and developer-site design systems; drop one into a project so an AI agent can build pages in a matching style.

projects.name: browser-use/browser-use
projects.summary: 让 LLM Agent 像人一样操作浏览器完成任务（订日期、过验证码、订票等），提供开源的 Python/TypeScript 库、CLI、以及按浏览器小时计费（$0.02/小时）的云端浏览器服务，还有内置反爬和验证码解决能力的托管 Agent API。
projects.summary_en: Lets LLM agents operate a browser like a person to complete tasks (booking dates, passing CAPTCHAs, buying tickets, etc.). Offers open-source Python/TypeScript libraries, a CLI, a cloud browser service billed at $0.02 per browser-hour, and a hosted agent API with built-in anti-bot and CAPTCHA solving.

projects.name: earendil-works/pi
projects.summary: Pi Agent Harness 项目主页，包含自扩展的交互式编码 Agent CLI、带工具调用与状态管理的 Agent 运行时，以及统一多家模型（OpenAI/Anthropic/Google）的 LLM API 层。
projects.summary_en: Home of the Pi agent harness: a self-extending interactive coding-agent CLI, an agent runtime with tool calling and state management, and a unified LLM API layer across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

projects.name: openai/whisper
projects.summary: OpenAI 基于大规模弱监督训练的通用语音识别模型，支持多语种转写、语音翻译和语种识别，提供多种尺寸的开源权重与 Python 推理代码。
projects.summary_en: OpenAI's general-purpose speech recognition model trained with large-scale weak supervision, covering multilingual transcription, speech translation, and language identification, with open weights in several sizes.

projects.name: TauricResearch/TradingAgents
projects.summary: 多智能体 LLM 金融交易框架，多个专业化 Agent 协作完成选股、回测和交易决策，持续跟进最新模型与数据源。
projects.summary_en: Multi-agent LLM financial-trading framework in which specialized agents collaborate on stock selection, backtesting, and trading decisions, continuously tracking the latest models and data sources.

projects.name: JuliusBrussee/caveman
projects.summary: 让编码 Agent“说话像穴居人”一样精简的病毒式技能+代理工具，通过压缩输出减少约 65% 的 token 消耗，曾登上 GitHub Trending 和 Hacker News 第一名。
projects.summary_en: Viral skill-plus-proxy tool that makes coding agents "talk like a caveman": compressing output cuts token use by about 65%. Reached #1 on GitHub Trending and Hacker News.

projects.name: google-gemini/gemini-cli
projects.summary: Google 官方开源终端 AI Agent，把 Gemini 模型能力直接带进终端，个人账号免费额度 60 次/分钟，支持 Google 搜索、文件操作、Shell 命令和 MCP 扩展。
projects.summary_en: Google's official open-source terminal AI agent, bringing Gemini into the terminal. Personal accounts get a free quota of 60 requests per minute, with Google Search, file operations, shell commands, and MCP extensions.

projects.name: rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch
projects.summary: 配套图书《Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)》的官方代码仓库，手把手教你从零用 PyTorch 实现、预训练并微调一个类 GPT 的 LLM。
projects.summary_en: Official code repo for the book Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch), walking you step by step through implementing, pre-training, and fine-tuning a GPT-like LLM in PyTorch.

projects.name: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3
projects.summary: DeepSeek 官方发布的 6710 亿参数 MoE 大语言模型（每 token 激活 370 亿参数），采用多头潜在注意力（MLA）和 DeepSeekMoE 架构实现高效训练推理。
projects.summary_en: DeepSeek's 671B-parameter MoE large language model (37B activated per token), using Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and the DeepSeekMoE architecture for efficient training and inference.

projects.name: pytorch/pytorch
projects.summary: 以动态计算图和 GPU 加速著称的深度学习框架，提供类 NumPy 的张量运算与基于磁带的自动微分，是当前研究界与工业界最主流的训练框架。
projects.summary_en: A deep learning framework built on dynamic computation graphs and GPU acceleration, with NumPy-like tensors and tape-based autodiff; the dominant training framework in both research and industry.

projects.name: addyosmani/agent-skills
projects.summary: 面向 AI 编码 Agent 的生产级工程技能合集，把资深工程师在需求定义、方案设计、编码、测试、评审到上线全流程中的最佳实践打包成可复用技能。
projects.summary_en: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents, packaging senior-engineer best practices across requirements, design, coding, testing, review, and release into reusable skills.

projects.name: nexu-io/open-design
projects.summary: 开源的 Claude Design 替代品，本地优先桌面应用，把编码 Agent（Claude Code/Codex/Cursor/DeepSeek Harness 等 20+ CLI）变成设计引擎，可直接产出原型、着陆页、幻灯片等真实文件。
projects.summary_en: Open-source Claude Design alternative: a local-first desktop app that turns coding agents (20+ CLIs including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and DeepSeek Harness) into a design engine that directly produces real files such as prototypes, landing pages, and slides.

projects.name: karpathy/autoresearch
projects.summary: Andrej Karpathy 的实验性项目：让 AI Agent 在单张 GPU 上自动运行 nanochat 模型训练相关的研究工作，以虚构口吻记录“AI 自主搞科研”的过程。
projects.summary_en: Experimental Andrej Karpathy project: an AI agent autonomously runs nanochat training research on a single GPU, documenting "AI doing research on its own" in a fictional voice.

projects.name: hacksider/Deep-Live-Cam
projects.summary: 只需一张人脸图片即可对摄像头画面或视频实时换脸的工具，面向直播与视频创作，README 中附有使用免责声明。
projects.summary_en: A tool that swaps faces in live webcam feeds or videos in real time from a single source image, aimed at streaming and video creation; the README carries a usage disclaimer.

projects.name: punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers
projects.summary: MCP（Model Context Protocol）服务器的集合列表，收录各类可供 Agent 调用的 MCP server 实现。
projects.summary_en: Collection list of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, cataloging MCP server implementations that agents can call.

projects.name: paperclipai/paperclip
projects.summary: 开源的 AI Agent 团队编排应用，Node.js 服务端 + React 界面，让你像管理公司一样给一群 AI Agent 分配目标、追踪工作和成本——“如果 OpenClaw 是员工，Paperclip 就是公司”。
projects.summary_en: Open-source app for orchestrating teams of AI agents (Node.js server plus React UI): assign goals, track work, and track cost across a group of agents the way you would manage a company. "If OpenClaw is an employee, Paperclip is the company."

projects.name: thedotmack/claude-mem
projects.summary: 为 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Hermes 等各类 Agent 提供跨会话持久记忆的压缩系统，自动捕获会话内容、用 AI 压缩后在未来会话中注入相关上下文。
projects.summary_en: Compression-based persistent cross-session memory for agents such as Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, and Hermes: automatically captures session content, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context into future sessions.

projects.name: vllm-project/vllm
projects.summary: 源自 UC Berkeley Sky Computing Lab 的高吞吐、内存高效 LLM 推理与服务引擎，核心技术是 PagedAttention 和连续批处理，已发展成有 2000+ 贡献者的开源项目，是本地/自建 LLM 服务最常用的推理后端之一。
projects.summary_en: High-throughput, memory-efficient LLM inference and serving engine originating from UC Berkeley's Sky Computing Lab, built on PagedAttention and continuous batching. It has grown into an open-source project with 2,000+ contributors and is one of the most commonly used inference backends for local and self-hosted LLM serving.

projects.name: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
projects.summary: DeepSeek 官方发布的第一代推理模型，DeepSeek-R1-Zero 完全通过大规模强化学习（无需先做监督微调）训练出强大推理能力，R1 在此基础上加入冷启动数据以解决重复生成、语言混杂等问题。
projects.summary_en: DeepSeek's first-generation reasoning models. DeepSeek-R1-Zero gains strong reasoning purely through large-scale reinforcement learning with no supervised fine-tuning; R1 adds cold-start data on top to fix problems like repetition and language mixing.

projects.name: infiniflow/ragflow
projects.summary: 融合 RAG 与 Agent 能力的检索增强生成引擎，为 LLM 构建更优质的上下文层。
projects.summary_en: Retrieval-augmented generation engine that fuses RAG with agent capabilities to build a better context layer for LLMs.

projects.name: Leonxlnx/taste-skill
projects.summary: 给 AI 编码 Agent“审美”的技能，防止生成千篇一律的模板化前端设计，定位为“反套路前端框架”。
projects.summary_en: A skill that gives AI coding agents "taste" and prevents generic, template-looking front-end designs; positioned as an "anti-cliché front-end framework".

projects.name: microsoft/ML-For-Beginners
projects.summary: 微软的 12 周、26 课时经典机器学习课程，带 52 个测验，以 scikit-learn 为主，支持多语言。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's 12-week, 26-lesson classic machine learning curriculum with 52 quizzes, centered on scikit-learn and available in many languages.

projects.name: opencv/opencv
projects.summary: 开源计算机视觉库，涵盖图像处理、特征检测、相机标定、目标跟踪与深度学习模型推理，C++ 实现并提供 Python 等语言绑定。
projects.summary_en: The open-source computer vision library covering image processing, feature detection, camera calibration, tracking, and deep-learning inference, written in C++ with Python and other bindings.

projects.name: fighting41love/funNLP

It builds a high-fidelity parallel digital world from real-world seed information such as news, draft policies, and financial signals, lets many agents with distinct personas and long-term memory interact freely, and uses the evolution to project future trends.
