projects.summary_en: Community-maintained multi-provider LLM aggregator that combines accessible free models and endpoints into one OpenAI-compatible REST API, with a local GUI and Python/JS clients.

projects.name: Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm
projects.summary: 本地优先的一体化 AI 应用，可对接自己的文档聊天、用 AI Agent 自动化复杂工作流，多用户、高度可配置，桌面端（Mac/Windows/Linux）和移动端均已开源。
projects.summary_en: Local-first all-in-one AI app: chat with your own documents and automate complex workflows with AI agents. Multi-user and highly configurable; desktop (Mac/Windows/Linux) and mobile apps are open source.

projects.name: mem0ai/mem0
projects.summary: 为 AI Agent 提供的记忆层基础设施，即插即用地让上下文跨会话持久化，新版记忆算法在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval 等基准上大幅提升准确率和延迟表现。
projects.summary_en: Memory-layer infrastructure for AI agents: plug-and-play cross-session context persistence. The new memory algorithm greatly improves accuracy and latency on benchmarks such as LoCoMo and LongMemEval.

projects.name: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis
projects.summary: LLM 驱动的多市场（A股/港股/美股/日股/韩股/台股）股票智能分析系统，聚合行情与实时新闻生成决策看板，支持零成本定时运行并推送到企业微信/飞书/Telegram 等渠道。
projects.summary_en: LLM-driven multi-market stock analysis system (A-shares, Hong Kong, US, Japan, Korea, Taiwan) that aggregates quotes and real-time news into a decision dashboard. Runs on a schedule at zero cost and pushes to WeCom, Feishu, Telegram, and other channels.

projects.name: usestrix/strix
projects.summary: 开源 AI 渗透测试工具，自主 AI“黑客”像真实攻击者一样动态运行代码、发现漏洞并通过实际 PoC 验证，可无缝集成进 GitHub Actions/CI-CD 在 PR 阶段自动扫描。
projects.summary_en: Open-source AI penetration-testing tool: autonomous AI "hackers" dynamically run code like real attackers, find vulnerabilities, and validate them with actual PoCs. Integrates into GitHub Actions/CI-CD to scan automatically at the PR stage.

projects.name: gsd-build/get-shit-done
projects.summary: 面向 Claude Code 的轻量元提示、上下文工程与规格驱动开发体系。仓库已不再是主开发地，项目迁到 open-gsd/gsd-core 继续。
projects.summary_en: A lightweight meta-prompting, context engineering, and spec-driven development system for Claude Code. This repository is no longer the active home; development continues in open-gsd/gsd-core.

projects.name: keras-team/keras
projects.summary: 面向人的深度学习框架，Keras 3 是多后端实现，可在 JAX、TensorFlow、PyTorch 上运行同一份模型代码。
projects.summary_en: A deep learning framework designed for humans; Keras 3 is multi-backend, running the same model code on JAX, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.

projects.name: virattt/ai-hedge-fund
projects.summary: 用多个 AI 角色协作做交易决策的对冲基金概念验证项目，仅用于教育与研究，不执行真实交易。
projects.summary_en: A proof-of-concept AI hedge fund in which several AI personas collaborate on trading decisions, intended for education and research and not for real trading.

projects.name: karpathy/nanoGPT
projects.summary: Karpathy 编写的最小化 GPT 训练与微调仓库，用几百行 PyTorch 复现 GPT-2 规模模型的训练。作者已说明该仓库过时，推荐改用 nanochat。
projects.summary_en: Karpathy's minimal repository for training and fine-tuning GPTs, reproducing GPT-2-scale training in a few hundred lines of PyTorch. The author now marks it as outdated and points to nanochat.

projects.name: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
projects.summary: 跨 Reddit、X、YouTube、Hacker News、Polymarket 等平台调研任意话题并生成有依据摘要的 Agent 技能，按点赞数、真实资金等信号而非编辑好恶排序。
projects.summary_en: Agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, and more, then writes a sourced summary ranked by signals such as upvotes and real money rather than editorial preference.

projects.name: jingyaogong/minimind
projects.summary: 从零开始、仅需几块钱成本和 2 小时训练时间即可训练出约 6400 万参数的超小语言模型 MiniMind，开源了预训练、SFT、LoRA、RLHF、蒸馏等大模型全流程的极简 PyTorch 实现，兼具复现项目与教程性质。
projects.summary_en: Trains a tiny ~64M-parameter language model, MiniMind, from scratch for a few yuan and about 2 hours. Open-sources minimal PyTorch implementations of the full LLM pipeline (pre-training, SFT, LoRA, RLHF, distillation), serving as both a reproduction project and a tutorial.

projects.name: PlexPt/awesome-chatgpt-prompts-zh
projects.summary: ChatGPT 中文调教指南，按学术论文、创意写作等场景整理提示词使用方法，帮助中文用户更好地引导大模型输出。
projects.summary_en: Chinese-language ChatGPT prompting guide that organizes prompt techniques by scenario such as academic papers and creative writing, helping Chinese-speaking users steer LLM output better.

projects.name: sansan0/TrendRadar
projects.summary: AI 驱动的舆情与热点监控工具，聚合多平台热榜和 RSS 订阅、支持关键词精准筛选，AI 智能筛选新闻、翻译并生成简报直推手机，可接入 MCP 架构做自然语言分析。
projects.summary_en: AI-driven public-opinion and trending-topic monitor: aggregates multi-platform trending lists and RSS feeds, supports precise keyword filtering, and uses AI to screen and translate news and push digests to your phone. Connects to MCP for natural-language analysis.

projects.name: upstash/context7
projects.summary: 为 LLM 和 AI 代码编辑器提供最新版本代码文档的平台，把最新、版本对应的文档和代码示例直接注入提示词，避免模型因训练数据过时而产生幻觉 API。
projects.summary_en: Platform that gives LLMs and AI code editors up-to-date, version-specific code documentation, injecting current docs and examples straight into the prompt so models stop hallucinating APIs from stale training data.

projects.name: RVC-Boss/GPT-SoVITS
projects.summary: 少样本语音克隆与文字转语音 WebUI，几秒到一分钟的参考音频即可零样本或微调出目标音色，含数据切分、标注与训练工具。
projects.summary_en: A few-shot voice cloning and text-to-speech WebUI that produces a target voice from seconds to a minute of reference audio, with zero-shot and fine-tuning modes plus dataset splitting and labeling tools.

projects.name: pathwaycom/pathway
projects.summary: 支持流处理、实时分析、LLM 管道和 RAG 的 Python ETL 框架，同一套代码可在本地开发、CI/CD 测试和生产环境的批处理/流式场景间无缝切换。
projects.summary_en: Python ETL framework for stream processing, real-time analytics, LLM pipelines, and RAG. The same code runs in local development, CI/CD testing, and production, in batch or streaming mode.

projects.name: ultralytics/ultralytics
projects.summary: Ultralytics 的 YOLO 系列模型库，覆盖目标检测、实例分割、姿态估计、分类与跟踪，提供训练、验证、导出与部署的统一接口。
projects.summary_en: Ultralytics' YOLO model library covering object detection, instance segmentation, pose estimation, classification, and tracking, with one interface for training, validation, export, and deployment.

projects.name: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
projects.summary: 面向 AI 工程的系统性课程，523 节课覆盖深度学习、LLM、Agent、计算机视觉等主题，多语言翻译版本由机器翻译自动生成并提交到仓库。
projects.summary_en: Systematic AI-engineering course: 523 lessons across deep learning, LLMs, agents, computer vision, and more. Translations are machine-generated and committed to the repo automatically.

projects.name: calesthio/OpenMontage
projects.summary: 号称全球首个开源“agentic 视频制作系统”，包含 12 条生产流水线、100+ 工具和 700+ 技能/生产知识文件，把 AI 编码助手变成完整的视频制作工作室。
projects.summary_en: Billed as the world's first open-source "agentic video production system", with 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, and 700+ skill and production-knowledge files that turn an AI coding assistant into a full video studio.

projects.name: microsoft/autogen
projects.summary: 已进入维护模式的多智能体应用编程框架，官方建议新用户转向其后续产品 Microsoft Agent Framework，现由社区继续维护。
projects.summary_en: Multi-agent application programming framework now in maintenance mode. Microsoft recommends new users move to its successor, Microsoft Agent Framework; the community continues to maintain it.

projects.name: CorentinJ/Real-Time-Voice-Cloning
projects.summary: SV2TTS 的开源实现：用几秒参考音频克隆声音并实时合成任意文本，由说话人编码器、合成器和声码器三部分组成，源自作者的硕士论文。
projects.summary_en: An open-source implementation of SV2TTS that clones a voice from seconds of audio and synthesizes arbitrary text in real time, with a speaker encoder, synthesizer, and vocoder; it began as the author's master's thesis.

projects.name: BerriAI/litellm
projects.summary: 统一 100+ LLM 提供商调用格式的 AI 网关，Rust 核心 + Python SDK，可作为库直接调用，也能部署成团队共用的代理服务，附带成本追踪、护栏和负载均衡。
projects.summary_en: AI gateway that unifies the call format of 100+ LLM providers. Rust core plus Python SDK; use it as a library or deploy it as a shared team proxy, with cost tracking, guardrails, and load balancing.

projects.name: meta-llama/llama
projects.summary: Meta 早期的 Llama 模型推理代码仓库。Llama 3.1 起相关仓库已合并到 Llama Stack 与新仓库，本仓库标注为弃用。
projects.summary_en: Meta's early inference code for Llama models. Since Llama 3.1 the code lives in consolidated repositories and Llama Stack, and this repository is marked deprecated.

projects.name: MemPalace/mempalace
projects.summary: 号称“评测最充分的开源 AI 记忆系统”，本地优先、逐字存储、后端可插拔，在 LongMemEval 基准上做到 96.6% 召回且零 API 调用成本。
projects.summary_en: Billed as "the most thoroughly benchmarked open-source AI memory system": local-first, verbatim storage, pluggable backends, reaching 96.6% recall on LongMemEval at zero API-call cost.

projects.name: crewAIInc/crewAI
projects.summary: 编排“角色扮演”自主 Agent 的多智能体框架，提供 Crews（自主协作）和 Flows（事件驱动精确控制）两套抽象，号称超 10 万开发者通过其社区课程认证。
projects.summary_en: Multi-agent framework for orchestrating role-playing autonomous agents, with two abstractions: Crews (autonomous collaboration) and Flows (event-driven precise control). Says over 100,000 developers have been certified through its community courses.

projects.name: pathwaycom/llm-app
projects.summary: 开箱即用的 RAG/AI 管道/企业搜索云模板集合，与 Sharepoint、Google Drive、S3、Kafka、PostgreSQL 等实时数据源保持同步，Docker 友好。
projects.summary_en: Ready-to-run cloud templates for RAG, AI pipelines, and enterprise search that stay in sync with live data sources such as SharePoint, Google Drive, S3, Kafka, and PostgreSQL. Docker-friendly.

projects.name: FoundationAgents/OpenManus
projects.summary: MetaGPT 团队在 3 小时内搭建的开源版 Manus 复刻项目，无需邀请码即可体验类似 Manus 的通用 Agent 能力，仍在持续迭代中。
projects.summary_en: Open-source Manus clone built by the MetaGPT team in three hours, offering Manus-like general agent capabilities without an invite code. Still under active iteration.

projects.name: karpathy/nanochat
projects.summary: Andrej Karpathy 出品的最简 LLM 训练 Harness，单 GPU 节点即可跑通分词、预训练、微调、评估、推理全流程，用约 100 美元、8×H100 跑 2 小时即可训练出堪比 2019 年耗资 4.3 万美元的 GPT-2 级别模型。
projects.summary_en: Andrej Karpathy's minimal LLM training harness: tokenization, pre-training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and inference on a single GPU node. About $100 and 2 hours on 8×H100 trains a model comparable to the GPT-2 class that cost $43,000 in 2019.

projects.name: ultralytics/yolov5
projects.summary: 基于 PyTorch 的 YOLOv5 目标检测、实例分割与分类实现，以易用、快速和丰富的导出格式著称，是 YOLO 生态中最广泛使用的版本之一。
projects.summary_en: A PyTorch implementation of YOLOv5 for object detection, instance segmentation, and classification, known for ease of use, speed, and broad export formats; one of the most widely used YOLO releases.

projects.name: scutan90/DeepLearning-500-questions
projects.summary: 《深度学习 500 问》：以问答形式梳理概率、线性代数、机器学习、深度学习与计算机视觉等常见问题，也是同名出版物的开源版。
projects.summary_en: Deep Learning 500 Questions: a Q&A-style review of probability, linear algebra, machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision, and the open version of the book of the same name.

projects.name: deepfakes/faceswap
projects.summary: 基于深度学习识别并替换图片与视频中人脸的开源软件，带图形界面，包含提取、训练与转换的完整流程。
projects.summary_en: Open-source software that uses deep learning to recognize and swap faces in images and videos, with a GUI covering extraction, training, and conversion.

projects.name: zylon-ai/private-gpt
projects.summary: PrivateGPT：把本地模型变成生产级 AI 应用的 API 层，提供 RAG、技能与工具等能力，强调数据不出本机。
projects.summary_en: PrivateGPT: an API layer that turns local models into production AI applications, providing RAG, skills, and tools while keeping data on the user's own machine.

projects.name: hugohe3/ppt-master
projects.summary: 把文档或主题自动转成原生 PowerPoint 演示文稿的 AI 工具，支持原生形状、转场动画、数据图表、基于演讲者备注的语音旁白，以及自定义 pptx 模板。
projects.summary_en: AI tool that automatically turns documents or topics into native PowerPoint decks, with native shapes, transitions, data charts, narration based on speaker notes, and custom pptx templates.

projects.name: ageitgey/face_recognition
projects.summary: 基于 dlib 的 Python 人脸识别库，一行代码即可完成人脸检测、特征点定位和身份比对，并附带命令行工具。
projects.summary_en: A Python face recognition library built on dlib that handles face detection, landmark location, and identity matching in a few lines, plus a command-line tool.

projects.name: Alishahryar1/free-claude-code
projects.summary: 聚合 56 个合规免费/付费/订阅/本地模型提供商、覆盖 11 款编码 Agent 的统一模型目录和多协议客户端接入方案，每月可用 13 亿+免费 token。
projects.summary_en: Unified model catalog and multi-protocol client integration that aggregates 56 compliant free, paid, subscription, and local model providers across 11 coding agents, with 1.3B+ free tokens available per month.

projects.name: jamiepine/voicebox
projects.summary: 本地运行的开源 AI 语音工作室，覆盖声音克隆、语音合成和全局听写，并提供 API，可让 Agent 用自定义声音说话。
projects.summary_en: An open-source AI voice studio that runs locally, covering voice cloning, speech synthesis, and system-wide dictation, with an API so agents can speak in custom voices.

projects.name: Lordog/dive-into-llms
projects.summary: 上海交通大学《自然语言处理前沿技术》《人工智能安全技术》课程拓展而来的公益性大模型编程实践教程系列，覆盖数学推理、GUI Agent、大模型对齐等主题。
projects.summary_en: Public-benefit series of hands-on LLM programming tutorials grown out of Shanghai Jiao Tong University courses on frontier NLP and AI safety, covering math reasoning, GUI agents, LLM alignment, and more.

projects.name: FlowiseAI/Flowise
projects.summary: 可视化搭建 AI Agent 的低代码平台，项目已归档（development 停止），此前基于 LangChain 生态提供拖拽式 Agent/RAG/Chatbot 构建能力。
projects.summary_en: Low-code platform for visually building AI agents. Archived (development has stopped); previously offered drag-and-drop agent, RAG, and chatbot building on the LangChain ecosystem.

projects.name: AntonOsika/gpt-engineer
projects.summary: 早期的代码生成实验平台，用自然语言描述软件需求、让 AI 编写并执行代码，是后来商业化产品 Lovable 的前身。
projects.summary_en: Early code-generation experimentation platform: describe software in natural language and let AI write and run the code. The precursor to the commercial product Lovable.

projects.name: facebookresearch/segment-anything
projects.summary: Meta 的 Segment Anything 模型（SAM）推理代码与权重，可通过点、框等提示对任意图像分割出物体掩码；作者已发布视频版 SAM 2。
projects.summary_en: Meta's Segment Anything Model (SAM) inference code and weights, producing object masks for any image from point or box prompts; a video-capable SAM 2 has since been released separately.

projects.name: hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code
projects.summary: 精选的 Claude Code 资源合集，收录顶级技能、Agent、状态栏、开发者工具和插件，强调代码质量、安全性和原创性。
projects.summary_en: Curated Claude Code resources: top skills, agents, status lines, developer tools, and plugins, with an emphasis on quality, security, and originality.

projects.name: aaif-goose/goose
projects.summary: 原生开源 AI Agent（桌面应用+CLI+API），不局限于代码建议，可用于研究、写作、自动化、数据分析等任意任务，兼容 15+ 模型提供商，支持用已有的 Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini 订阅通过 ACP 协议调用。
projects.summary_en: Native open-source AI agent (desktop app, CLI, and API) that goes beyond code suggestions to handle research, writing, automation, data analysis, and more. Works with 15+ model providers, and can use existing Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini subscriptions through the ACP protocol.

projects.name: lencx/ChatGPT
projects.summary: 非官方的 ChatGPT 桌面客户端（Mac/Windows/Linux），基于 Tauri 打包；作者后续在其继任项目 Noi 中延续了 AI 桌面包装应用的思路。
projects.summary_en: Unofficial ChatGPT desktop client (Mac/Windows/Linux) packaged with Tauri; the author carried the idea of AI desktop wrapper apps forward in its successor project, Noi.

projects.name: microsoft/VibeVoice
projects.summary: 微软的开源前沿语音 AI 系列，包含长文本多说话人语音合成和流式语音识别模型，支持自定义热词与多语种。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's open-source frontier voice AI family, including long-form multi-speaker speech synthesis and a streaming speech recognition model with custom hotwords and multilingual support.

projects.name: heygen-com/hyperframes
projects.summary: 把 HTML、CSS、媒体和可寻址动画渲染成确定性 MP4 视频的开源框架，可通过 CLI 本地使用、作为 AI 编码 Agent 的技能调用，或作为托管创作工作流背后的渲染内核。
projects.summary_en: Open-source framework that renders HTML, CSS, media, and addressable animations into deterministic MP4 video. Use it locally from the CLI, call it as a skill from an AI coding agent, or run it as the rendering core of a hosted creative workflow.

projects.name: ggml-org/whisper.cpp
projects.summary: Whisper 语音识别模型的纯 C/C++ 移植，无外部依赖，针对 Apple Silicon 与 CPU 做了量化和加速，适合端侧离线转写。
projects.summary_en: A dependency-free C/C++ port of the Whisper speech recognition model, quantized and optimized for Apple Silicon and CPUs, suited to offline on-device transcription.

projects.name: bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD
projects.summary: 敏捷 AI 驱动开发方法论（Agile AI Driven Development），覆盖从想法到可工作软件的全流程决策、上下文传递和架构设计，可端到端使用也可把简报/规范/架构接入现有交付流程。
projects.summary_en: Agile AI-Driven Development methodology covering decisions, context handoff, and architecture from idea to working software. Use it end to end, or plug briefs, specs, and architecture into an existing delivery process.

projects.name: router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI
projects.summary: 把 Antigravity、ChatGPT Codex、Claude Code、Grok Build 等多种编码 Agent CLI 包装成 OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Codex 兼容的 API 服务，可通过 API 方式复用这些 CLI 自带的免费模型额度。
projects.summary_en: Wraps coding-agent CLIs such as Antigravity, ChatGPT Codex, Claude Code, and Grok Build as OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Codex-compatible API services, so you can reuse the free model quotas those CLIs come with through an API.

projects.name: lllyasviel/Fooocus
projects.summary: 以 Midjourney 式体验为目标的离线开源文生图软件，内置提示词优化与参数预设，减少手动调参。
projects.summary_en: Offline open-source image generation software that aims for a Midjourney-like experience, with built-in prompt enhancement and presets that reduce manual tuning.

projects.name: anthropics/claude-cookbooks
projects.summary: Anthropic 官方 Claude 使用范例合集，提供可直接复制进项目的代码片段，帮助开发者上手用 Claude API 构建应用。
projects.summary_en: Official collection of Claude usage examples, with copy-paste code snippets that help developers get started building apps on the Claude API.

projects.name: blader/humanizer
projects.summary: 去除 AI 生成文本“机器味”的 Agent 技能，基于维基百科编辑用来识别 AI 生成内容的《Signs of AI writing》准则构建，适用于 Claude Code、Codex 等支持技能的 Agent。
projects.summary_en: Agent skill that removes the "machine feel" from AI-generated text, built on Wikipedia editors' "Signs of AI writing" guidelines. Works with skill-capable agents such as Claude Code and Codex.

projects.name: VoltAgent/awesome-openclaw-skills
projects.summary: 从 OpenClaw 官方技能注册中心（ClawHub）筛选、分类整理的 5000+ 社区技能合集，方便按类目发现和安装 OpenClaw 技能。
projects.summary_en: Collection of 5,000+ community skills filtered and categorized from OpenClaw's official skill registry (ClawHub), making it easy to discover and install OpenClaw skills by category.

projects.name: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
projects.summary: Chrome DevTools 团队官方出品的 MCP server，让编码 Agent（Antigravity/Claude/Cursor/Copilot 等）能控制和检查真实 Chrome 浏览器，获得性能分析、深度调试等能力。
projects.summary_en: Official MCP server from the Chrome DevTools team that lets coding agents (Antigravity, Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) control and inspect a real Chrome browser, with performance profiling and deep debugging.

projects.name: run-llama/llama_index
projects.summary: 文档处理与 RAG 框架，当前重心已转向文档解析与信息抽取（配套商业化产品 LlamaParse），并推出免费开源的极速文本解析器 LiteParse 等衍生项目。
projects.summary_en: Document-processing and RAG framework whose focus has shifted to document parsing and information extraction (with the commercial LlamaParse product), and which has spun off projects such as the free open-source fast text parser LiteParse.

projects.name: ayghri/i-have-adhd
projects.summary: 让编码 Agent 别“绕圈子藏答案”的技能，强制输出先给结论、步骤编号，去掉“希望这对你有帮助”之类的废话。
projects.summary_en: A skill that stops coding agents from burying the answer: forces conclusion-first output with numbered steps and drops filler like "I hope this helps".

projects.name: CherryHQ/cherry-studio
projects.summary: 支持多个 LLM 提供商的桌面 AI 生产力工作室，集智能聊天、自主 Agent 和 300+ 预设助手于一体，可接入 OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic 云服务，也支持 Ollama/LM Studio 本地模型。
projects.summary_en: Desktop AI productivity studio supporting multiple LLM providers, combining chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ preset assistants. Connects to OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic cloud services as well as local models through Ollama and LM Studio.

projects.name: xai-org/grok-1
projects.summary: xAI 官方开源的 Grok-1 模型权重发布，314B 参数的 MoE 模型，提供用于加载和运行该模型的 JAX 示例代码。
projects.summary_en: xAI's official open release of the Grok-1 model weights: a 314B-parameter MoE model, with JAX example code for loading and running it.

projects.name: coreyhaines31/marketingskills
projects.summary: 面向技术型营销人和创业者的 Agent 技能合集，涵盖转化率优化、文案、SEO、数据分析和增长工程，适配 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等支持 Agent Skills 规范的工具。
projects.summary_en: Agent skill collection for technical marketers and founders, covering conversion optimization, copywriting, SEO, data analysis, and growth engineering. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other tools that support the Agent Skills spec.

projects.name: bojieli/ai-agent-book
projects.summary: 《深入理解 AI Agent：设计原理与工程实践》开源图书主仓库，围绕“Agent = LLM + 上下文 + 工具”这一核心公式，用十章内容从原理讲到工程实战，提供正文、配图与配套代码。
projects.summary_en: Main repo of the open-source book on AI agent design principles and engineering practice. Built around the formula "Agent = LLM + context + tools", it walks through ten chapters from principles to hands-on engineering, with text, figures, and companion code.

projects.name: Avik-Jain/100-Days-Of-ML-Code
projects.summary: 按 Siraj Raval 提出的「机器学习百日编程」整理的每日学习记录，含数据预处理、线性回归等主题的信息图与代码。
projects.summary_en: A day-by-day record of the 100 Days of ML Coding challenge proposed by Siraj Raval, with infographics and code for topics such as preprocessing and linear regression.

projects.name: multica-ai/multica
projects.summary: 让人类和 AI 编码 Agent 像同一个团队协作的开源看板式工作区，Agent 领取任务、汇报进度、遇阻上报、提交评审，可自托管、兼容已有的各类 Agent CLI。
projects.summary_en: Open-source kanban-style workspace where humans and AI coding agents work as one team: agents pick up tasks, report progress, escalate blockers, and submit for review. Self-hostable and compatible with existing agent CLIs.

projects.name: roboflow/supervision
projects.summary: 可复用的计算机视觉工具库，提供检测结果的统一数据结构、标注绘制、跟踪、区域计数与数据集处理，可对接多种检测模型。
projects.summary_en: A reusable computer vision toolkit with a unified detections data structure, annotators, tracking, zone counting, and dataset utilities that work with many detection models.

projects.name: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
projects.summary: 让“所有软件都能被 Agent 原生使用”的工具，配套 CLI-Hub 让你浏览、安装和管理社区构建的各类命令行工具，弥合 AI Agent 与现有软件生态之间的鸿沟。
projects.summary_en: Makes "all software natively usable by agents", with a companion CLI-Hub to browse, install, and manage community-built command-line tools, bridging AI agents and the existing software ecosystem.

projects.name: elder-plinius/CL4R1T4S
projects.summary: 汇总 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Grok、Perplexity、Cursor 等主流 AI 系统的完整泄露系统提示词、准则与工具定义，主张“AI 系统透明化”。
projects.summary_en: Collects complete leaked system prompts, guidelines, and tool definitions from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, Cursor, and other major AI systems, advocating "AI system transparency".

projects.name: jakevdp/PythonDataScienceHandbook
projects.summary: 《Python 数据科学手册》全文的 Jupyter Notebook，讲解 IPython、NumPy、pandas、Matplotlib 与 scikit-learn。
projects.summary_en: The full text of the Python Data Science Handbook as Jupyter notebooks, covering IPython, NumPy, pandas, Matplotlib, and scikit-learn.

projects.name: upscayl/upscayl
projects.summary: 跨平台的 AI 图像放大桌面软件，基于 Real-ESRGAN 等超分模型，支持批量处理和自定义模型。
projects.summary_en: A cross-platform desktop app for AI image upscaling built on super-resolution models such as Real-ESRGAN, with batch processing and custom-model support.

projects.name: Imbad0202/academic-research-skills
projects.summary: 面向 Claude Code 的学术科研技能包，覆盖从研究、写作、审阅、修订到定稿的全流程，强调人类始终掌握关键决策、AI 只负责查文献/核对格式等体力活；内置多阶段完整性校验，防止捏造引用和方法论造假。
projects.summary_en: Academic research skill pack for Claude Code covering the full flow of research, writing, review, revision, and finalization. Stresses that humans keep the key decisions while AI handles legwork like finding literature and checking formatting; built-in multi-stage integrity checks guard against fabricated citations and methodology fraud.

projects.name: pandas-dev/pandas
projects.summary: Python 的数据分析与处理库，提供 DataFrame 等结构和丰富的清洗、聚合、时间序列工具。
projects.summary_en: A Python data analysis and manipulation library offering DataFrames and rich tools for cleaning, aggregation, and time series.

projects.name: moeru-ai/airi
projects.summary: 自托管的“你的AI伴侣”项目，目标是复刻 Neuro-sama 式虚拟角色，支持实时语音聊天、玩 Minecraft/Factorio，跨 Web/macOS/Windows。
projects.summary_en: Self-hosted "your AI companion" project aiming to recreate Neuro-sama-style virtual characters, with real-time voice chat and the ability to play Minecraft and Factorio, across Web, macOS, and Windows.

projects.name: debpalash/VoiceStudio
projects.summary: 完全本地运行的 ElevenLabs 开源替代，覆盖声音克隆、声音设计、视频配音、听写转写和有声书制作，宣称支持 600 多种语言。
projects.summary_en: A fully local open-source ElevenLabs alternative covering voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation, claiming support for over 600 languages.

projects.name: GokuMohandas/Made-With-ML
projects.summary: 教你设计、开发、部署并迭代生产级机器学习应用的课程，涵盖 MLOps、测试与流水线。
projects.summary_en: A course on designing, developing, deploying, and iterating production-grade ML applications, covering MLOps, testing, and pipelines.

projects.name: mudler/LocalAI
projects.summary: 开源本地 AI 引擎，用一套 OpenAI/Anthropic/ElevenLabs 兼容 API 统一跑 LLM、视觉、语音、图像、视频等任意模态模型，按需拉取 llama.cpp/vLLM/whisper.cpp 等后端，内置支持工具调用、RAG、MCP 和技能的自主 Agent。
projects.summary_en: Open-source local AI engine that runs LLMs, vision, speech, image, and video models of any modality behind a single OpenAI/Anthropic/ElevenLabs-compatible API, pulling backends such as llama.cpp, vLLM, and whisper.cpp on demand. Includes autonomous agents with built-in tool calling, RAG, MCP, and skills.

projects.name: Aider-AI/aider
projects.summary: 在终端里跟 AI 结对编程的开源工具，支持 Claude/GPT/Gemini 等主流模型，能理解并编辑本地 Git 仓库中的多文件代码，是最早一批命令行编码 Agent 之一。
projects.summary_en: Open-source AI pair-programming tool for the terminal. Works with Claude, GPT, Gemini, and other leading models, understands and edits multi-file code in local Git repos, and is one of the earliest command-line coding agents.

projects.name: QuantumNous/new-api
projects.summary: 自托管 AI 网关，把 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Azure、Bedrock、DeepSeek、通义千问等上游模型统一转换成 OpenAI/Claude/Gemini 兼容格式，用于团队级模型分发、路由和用量成本管理。
projects.summary_en: Self-hosted AI gateway that converts upstream models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Azure, Bedrock, DeepSeek, Tongyi Qianwen, and more) into OpenAI/Claude/Gemini-compatible formats for team-level model distribution, routing, and usage-cost management.

projects.name: microsoft/qlib
projects.summary: 微软的面向 AI 的量化投资平台，涵盖数据处理、模型训练、回测与组合管理，并加入基于 LLM 的自主演化研发 Agent。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's AI-oriented quantitative investment platform covering data processing, model training, backtesting, and portfolio management, with newly added LLM-based autonomous R&D agents.

projects.name: kepano/obsidian-skills
projects.summary: 为 Obsidian 打造的 Agent Skills 包，教 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等支持技能规范的 Agent 使用 Obsidian CLI 及 Markdown/Bases/JSON Canvas 等开放格式读写笔记库。
projects.summary_en: Agent Skills pack for Obsidian that teaches skill-capable agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode to read and write note vaults using the Obsidian CLI and open formats such as Markdown, Bases, and JSON Canvas.

projects.name: HKUDS/nanobot
projects.summary: 超轻量、可自托管的 Python 个人 AI Agent 框架，内置 WebUI、终端和聊天应用（Telegram/Discord/微信/飞书等）三种入口，核心代码精简易读，集成长期记忆、MCP、多模型路由、多 Agent 委派、定时自动化和 OpenAI 兼容 API。
projects.summary_en: Ultra-light, self-hostable Python personal AI agent framework with three entry points (WebUI, terminal, and chat apps such as Telegram/Discord/WeChat/Feishu). Compact, readable core; includes long-term memory, MCP, multi-model routing, multi-agent delegation, scheduled automation, and an OpenAI-compatible API.

projects.name: KeygraphHQ/shannon
projects.summary: 自主 AI 渗透测试 Agent，分析源码、定位攻击路径并执行真实漏洞利用来验证漏洞（无利用不出报告），支持 CI/CD 集成、SARIF 输出和 BYOK。
projects.summary_en: Autonomous AI penetration-testing agent that analyzes source code, finds attack paths, and runs real exploits to validate vulnerabilities (no exploit, no report). Supports CI/CD integration, SARIF output, and BYOK.

projects.name: oobabooga/textgen
projects.summary: 本地大模型开源桌面应用，支持文本/视觉/工具调用，兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic API，100% 本地运行保护隐私。
projects.summary_en: Open-source desktop app for running LLMs locally, with text, vision, and tool calling, compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs. Runs 100% locally to protect privacy.

projects.name: exo-explore/exo
projects.summary: 把多台设备连成一个 AI 集群本地跑大模型的工具，支持 Thunderbolt RDMA 直连降低设备间延迟、自动设备发现与拓扑感知的模型自动切分，兼容 OpenAI/Claude/Ollama API。
projects.summary_en: Connects multiple devices into an AI cluster to run large models locally. Supports Thunderbolt RDMA for low inter-device latency, automatic device discovery, topology-aware model partitioning, and OpenAI/Claude/Ollama-compatible APIs.

projects.name: abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus
projects.summary: 零服务器的代码智能引擎，把整个代码库索引成知识图谱（依赖、调用链、执行流），通过 MCP 工具暴露给 AI Agent，让 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等在编辑前先看到完整架构视图。
projects.summary_en: Zero-server code intelligence engine that indexes a whole codebase into a knowledge graph (dependencies, call chains, execution flows) and exposes it to AI agents over MCP, so Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and others see the full architecture before editing.

projects.name: hiroi-sora/Umi-OCR
projects.summary: 免费离线的 OCR 桌面软件，支持截图识别、批量图片与 PDF 识别、排除水印和页眉页脚，并提供命令行与 HTTP 接口。
projects.summary_en: A free offline OCR desktop application supporting screenshot OCR, batch image and PDF recognition, and watermark and header exclusion, with command-line and HTTP interfaces.

projects.name: K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills
projects.summary: 把任意 AI Agent 变成“AI 科学家”的技能库，165 个经过验证的科研技能加 100+ 科学数据库，覆盖生物、化学、医学、药物发现，兼容 Cursor/Claude Code/Codex 等主流 Agent 及开放 Agent Skills 标准。
projects.summary_en: Skill library that turns any AI agent into an "AI scientist": 165 validated research skills plus 100+ scientific databases across biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and the open Agent Skills standard.

projects.name: zhayujie/CowAgent
projects.summary: 开源超级 AI 助理与 Agent Harness，能主动规划任务、操控电脑与外部服务、创建并运行技能、积累长期记忆，支持多 Agent 团队协作，可 7x24 小时跑在个人电脑或服务器上并接入主流 IM 平台。
projects.summary_en: Open-source super AI assistant and agent harness that proactively plans tasks, operates computers and external services, creates and runs skills, and builds long-term memory. Supports multi-agent team collaboration and runs 24/7 on a personal computer or server, connecting to mainstream IM platforms.

projects.name: sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills
projects.summary: 本地优先的技能发现与管理控制台（AAS Core），收录 2400+ 可安装 SKILL.md，提供 CLI、本地 MCP、目录浏览和 Workbench，帮助 Codex/Claude 在真正改动前先检索、圈定并预览要用的技能集。
projects.summary_en: Local-first skill discovery and management console (AAS Core) indexing 2,400+ installable SKILL.md files, with a CLI, local MCP, catalog browsing, and a Workbench that helps Codex and Claude search, scope, and preview the skill set to use before making real changes.

projects.name: siyuan-note/siyuan
projects.summary: 隐私优先、自托管的知识工作空间，让人类与 AI Agent 协作完成从想法到洞察的知识管理，支持 MCP，Docker/K8s 部署。
projects.summary_en: Privacy-first, self-hosted knowledge workspace where humans and AI agents collaborate on knowledge management from idea to insight. Supports MCP and Docker/K8s deployment.

projects.name: milvus-io/milvus
projects.summary: 云原生高性能向量数据库，专为大规模向量近似最近邻检索设计，是 RAG 系统中最常用的开源向量库之一。
projects.summary_en: Cloud-native, high-performance vector database built for large-scale approximate nearest-neighbor search, and one of the most commonly used open-source vector stores in RAG systems.

projects.name: coqui-ai/TTS
projects.summary: 面向研究与生产的文字转语音深度学习工具包，提供预训练多语种模型、XTTS 声音克隆与流式合成，以及训练和微调脚本。
projects.summary_en: A deep learning toolkit for text-to-speech used in research and production, with pretrained multilingual models, XTTS voice cloning with streaming, and training and fine-tuning recipes.

projects.name: DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp
projects.summary: 高性能代码智能 MCP 服务器，用 tree-sitter AST 解析把代码库变成持久知识图谱，毫秒级索引、亚毫秒级查询，号称比逐文件探索节省 99% token、单一静态二进制零依赖。
projects.summary_en: High-performance code-intelligence MCP server that turns a codebase into a persistent knowledge graph via tree-sitter AST parsing, with millisecond indexing and sub-millisecond queries. Claims 99% fewer tokens than file-by-file exploration; a single static binary with zero dependencies.

projects.name: Yuan1z0825/nature-skills
projects.summary: 面向 Nature 期刊论文写作规范与科研绘图的技能包，含论文润色和图表生成核心功能，号称启发了 Google DeepMind 的 Science Skills。
projects.summary_en: Skill pack for Nature-journal paper-writing conventions and scientific figure making, with core features for polishing papers and generating figures. Claims to have inspired Google DeepMind's Science Skills.

projects.name: LibreChat-AI/LibreChat
projects.summary: 增强版 ChatGPT 开源替代品，集成 Agents、MCP、Skills 及 DeepSeek/Anthropic/OpenAI/Azure/Gemini 等几乎所有主流模型接口，支持多用户鉴权、Artifacts、Code Interpreter 等企业级功能。
projects.summary_en: Enhanced open-source ChatGPT alternative integrating Agents, MCP, Skills, and nearly every mainstream model API (DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure, Gemini, and more), with multi-user auth, Artifacts, Code Interpreter, and other enterprise features.

projects.name: janhq/jan
projects.summary: Jan 是可完全离线运行的开源 ChatGPT 替代品，可下载并运行本地大模型，也能接入云端模型 API。
projects.summary_en: Jan is an open-source ChatGPT replacement that runs fully offline, downloading and running local LLMs, and can also connect to cloud model APIs.

projects.name: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
projects.summary: 基于 Claude Code 搭建的个人求职自动化框架，自动评估职位、定制简历、写求职信、准备面试，作者用它拿到了 20 个面试和 1 份录用。
projects.summary_en: Personal job-search automation framework built on Claude Code: evaluates postings, tailors resumes, writes cover letters, and prepares interviews. The author landed 20 interviews and one offer with it.

projects.name: danielmiessler/Fabric
projects.summary: 用 AI 增强人类能力的开源框架，把众包收集的“模式”（Prompt 任务单元）按真实场景分类整理，命令行即可调用，解决 AI 能力多但难整合进日常工作流的问题。
projects.summary_en: Open-source framework for augmenting humans with AI. Crowdsourced "patterns" (prompt task units) are organized by real-world scenario and callable from the command line, tackling the problem that AI is powerful but hard to integrate into daily workflows.

projects.name: ray-project/ray
projects.summary: 面向 AI 的分布式计算引擎，核心是通用分布式运行时，并配有数据处理、训练、调参、强化学习和模型服务等库。
projects.summary_en: A distributed compute engine for AI: a general distributed runtime plus libraries for data processing, training, hyperparameter tuning, reinforcement learning, and model serving.

projects.name: aymericdamien/TensorFlow-Examples
projects.summary: 面向初学者的 TensorFlow 教程与示例，同时提供 Notebook 与源码，支持 TF v1 和 v2。
projects.summary_en: A beginner-friendly TensorFlow tutorial with examples as both notebooks and source code, supporting TF v1 and v2.

projects.name: gradio-app/gradio
projects.summary: 用几行 Python 为机器学习模型、API 或任意函数构建可分享的 Web 演示界面，可部署到 Hugging Face Spaces。
projects.summary_en: A Python package for building shareable web demos for ML models, APIs, or any function in a few lines, deployable to Hugging Face Spaces.

projects.name: vectorize-io/hindsight
projects.summary: 面向学习型 Agent 的记忆系统，聚焦让 Agent 从经验中持续进步而非只是复述对话历史，在 LongMemEval 等基准上取得业界领先的长期记忆准确率。
projects.summary_en: Memory system for learning agents, focused on helping agents keep improving from experience rather than merely replaying conversation history, with industry-leading long-term memory accuracy on benchmarks such as LongMemEval.

projects.name: chatanywhere/GPT_API_free
projects.summary: 免费大模型 API 中转服务，支持 GPT/DeepSeek/Claude/Gemini 等主流模型统一走 OpenAI 协议调用，免费额度每周 5 万点、每天 100 次，仅限个人非商业用途。
projects.summary_en: Free LLM API relay that exposes GPT, DeepSeek, Claude, Gemini, and other models through the OpenAI protocol. Free quota is 50,000 points per week and 100 calls per day, for personal non-commercial use only.

projects.name: vercel-labs/agent-browser
projects.summary: Vercel 官方出品的 AI Agent 浏览器自动化 CLI，Rust 原生实现，可下载独立 Chrome for Testing 运行，也能复用已装的 Chrome/Playwright/Puppeteer。
projects.summary_en: Vercel's browser-automation CLI for AI agents, implemented natively in Rust. Can download a standalone Chrome for Testing to run, or reuse an installed Chrome, Playwright, or Puppeteer.

projects.name: deepspeedai/DeepSpeed
projects.summary: 深度学习分布式训练与推理优化库，以 ZeRO 显存优化技术闻名，支持千亿/万亿参数模型的高效训练，被 LinkedIn 等用于生产级大模型蒸馏训练。
projects.summary_en: Distributed training and inference optimization library, best known for ZeRO memory optimization. Enables efficient training of hundred-billion to trillion-parameter models and is used by companies like LinkedIn for production LLM distillation.

projects.name: Wei-Shaw/sub2api
projects.summary: 开源 AI API 中转/订阅分发平台，让 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、Grok 等订阅可被多人拼车共享分摊成本，原生工具无缝接入，官方声明可能违反上游服务条款，风险自担。
projects.summary_en: Open-source AI API relay and subscription-distribution platform that lets several people share Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, and other subscriptions to split the cost, with native tools connecting seamlessly. The project itself states this may violate upstream terms of service; use at your own risk.

projects.name: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
projects.summary: 面向 Claude Code、Codex、Pi 的编辑级图表设计技能，纯 HTML+SVG 自包含输出，不用 Mermaid 默认丑图样式，支持架构图、流程图、时序图等十余种版式并可重绘已有的 draw.io/Mermaid 图。
projects.summary_en: Editorial-grade diagram-design skill for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained pure HTML+SVG output that avoids Mermaid's default styling, supports a dozen-plus layouts (architecture, flowchart, sequence, and more), and can redraw existing draw.io/Mermaid diagrams.

projects.name: alibaba/open-code-review
projects.summary: 阿里巴巴内部代码评审助手的开源版，混合确定性规则引擎+LLM Agent，能读取完整文件、搜索代码库定位上下文，产出精确到行级的深度评审意见，内置 NPE/线程安全/XSS/SQL 注入等多语言规则集。
projects.summary_en: Open-source version of Alibaba's internal code-review assistant. Combines a deterministic rule engine with an LLM agent that reads whole files and searches the codebase for context, producing line-level deep review comments, with built-in multi-language rule sets for NPEs, thread safety, XSS, SQL injection, and more.

projects.name: apachecn/ailearning
projects.summary: AiLearning：数据分析、机器学习实战、线性代数、PyTorch、NLTK 与 TF2 的中文学习路线与教程。
projects.summary_en: AiLearning: a Chinese learning path and tutorials covering data analysis, practical machine learning, linear algebra, PyTorch, NLTK, and TF2.

projects.name: langchain-ai/langgraph
projects.summary: LangChain 官方出品的低层级 Agent 编排框架，专注构建长时运行、有状态的 Agent，支持持久化执行、人类介入、长短期记忆和 LangSmith 可视化调试。
projects.summary_en: LangChain's low-level agent-orchestration framework for long-running, stateful agents, with durable execution, human-in-the-loop, short- and long-term memory, and LangSmith visual debugging.

projects.name: agno-agi/agno
projects.summary: 构建、运行、管理 Agent 平台的框架与运行时（AgentOS），提供 SDK 搭建 Agent、REST API 服务化部署、Web UI 管理，帮助团队拥有自己的 Agent 技术栈。
projects.summary_en: Framework and runtime (AgentOS) for building, running, and managing agent platforms. Provides an SDK for building agents, a REST API for serving them, and a web UI for management, so teams can own their agent stack.

projects.name: 666ghj/BettaFish
projects.summary: 从零实现的多智能体舆情分析系统“微舆”，AI 爬虫集群 7x24 小时覆盖国内外 30+ 社媒，5 类专业 Agent 加“论坛”辩论机制协同分析海量评论，预测舆情走向辅助决策。
projects.summary_en: Multi-agent public-opinion analysis system built from scratch ("Weiyu"). A crawler cluster covers 30+ social platforms 24/7, and five specialist agents plus a "forum" debate mechanism analyze large volumes of comments to forecast sentiment trends and support decisions.

projects.name: emilkowalski/skills
projects.summary: 面向设计师和工程师的动效/交互设计技能包，由 Vercel/Linear 背景的作者基于多年审美经验总结，帮 Agent 避免动效“没品味”的常见错误。
projects.summary_en: Motion and interaction-design skill pack for designers and engineers, distilled from years of taste by an author with Vercel/Linear background, helping agents avoid common "tasteless" motion mistakes.

projects.name: chatboxai/chatbox
projects.summary: 跨平台桌面/移动 AI 客户端，统一对接 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek 等模型，支持 Windows/Mac/Linux/iOS/Android。
projects.summary_en: Cross-platform desktop and mobile AI client that connects to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more. Supports Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS, and Android.

projects.name: luongnv89/claude-howto
projects.summary: 图解版 Claude Code 学习指南，用 Mermaid 图和可直接复制的模板教你从基础命令到编排 Agent、Hook、技能和 MCP 服务器的完整用法。
projects.summary_en: Illustrated Claude Code learning guide that uses Mermaid diagrams and copy-ready templates to teach everything from basic commands to orchestrating agents, hooks, skills, and MCP servers.

projects.name: herdrdev/herdr
projects.summary: 编码 Agent 的运行时终端复用器，Rust 编写，让 Claude Code/Codex/Cursor/OpenCode 等会话在断开 SSH 或关闭客户端后继续在后台服务器运行，可跨机器统一管理多个 Agent 面板并标记工作/阻塞/空闲状态。
projects.summary_en: Runtime terminal multiplexer for coding agents, written in Rust. Keeps Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and other sessions running on a background server after you disconnect SSH or close the client, and manages many agent panes across machines with working/blocked/idle status.

projects.name: hpcaitech/ColossalAI
projects.summary: 让大模型训练更便宜更快更易用的分布式训练系统，支持数据/流水线/张量并行等多种并行策略，提供一键云端 GPU 训练环境。
projects.summary_en: Distributed training system that makes large-model training cheaper, faster, and easier, with data, pipeline, tensor, and other parallelism strategies and a one-click cloud GPU training environment.

projects.name: AstrBotDevs/AstrBot
projects.summary: 开源一体化 Agent 聊天机器人平台，对接 QQ/微信/Discord/Telegram/Slack 等主流 IM，集成 LLM 对话、Agent、MCP、技能、知识库和 Agent 沙箱，号称是 openclaw 的替代品。
projects.summary_en: Open-source all-in-one agent chatbot platform that connects to QQ, WeChat, Discord, Telegram, Slack, and other IMs, integrating LLM chat, agents, MCP, skills, knowledge bases, and an agent sandbox. Positions itself as an alternative to openclaw.

projects.name: Hmbown/Codewhale
projects.summary: Rust 编写的开源终端编码 Agent，可读取项目、编辑文件、执行命令并用本地或托管模型校验结果，支持把大任务拆给不同角色/模型的多个 Agent 协作。
projects.summary_en: Open-source terminal coding agent written in Rust that reads projects, edits files, runs commands, and verifies results with local or hosted models. Can split large tasks among multiple agents with different roles or models.

projects.name: facebookresearch/faiss
projects.summary: Meta AI 研究院出品的稠密向量高效相似度检索与聚类库，支持 CPU/GPU、十亿级向量规模，是众多 RAG/向量检索系统底层依赖的基础库。
projects.summary_en: Meta AI Research's library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors. Supports CPU and GPU at billion-vector scale, and underpins many RAG and vector-search systems.

projects.name: zai-org/ChatGLM-6B
projects.summary: 智谱 AI（原清华 KEG 实验室）开源的双语对话大模型，62 亿参数，消费级显卡可本地部署，是国内最早一批开源可商用对话大模型之一。
projects.summary_en: Bilingual open conversational LLM from Zhipu AI (formerly Tsinghua's KEG lab): 6.2B parameters, deployable locally on consumer GPUs, and one of the earliest open, commercially usable Chinese chat models.

projects.name: PatrickJS/awesome-cursorrules
projects.summary: Cursor AI 编辑器项目规则（.cursor/rules）配置文件合集，按前端框架、后端、移动端、测试、安全等分类，帮助 Cursor 按项目定制行为。
projects.summary_en: Collection of Cursor AI editor project-rules (.cursor/rules) files, organized by front-end framework, back end, mobile, testing, security, and more, to customize Cursor's behavior per project.

projects.name: HKUDS/DeepTutor
projects.summary: 终身个性化辅导 Agent，多语言界面，支持工作区知识库、图文材料上传、任务看板与对话恢复，围绕 LightRAG 构建教育场景的深度检索能力。
projects.summary_en: Lifelong personalized tutoring agent with a multilingual interface, workspace knowledge bases, image-and-text material upload, a task board, and conversation recovery, built on LightRAG for deep retrieval in education.

projects.name: microsoft/BitNet
projects.summary: Microsoft 官方出品的 1-bit LLM 官方推理框架（bitnet.cpp），支持 CPU/GPU 上高效跑三值量化模型，并发布配套的 1-bit 嵌入模型与 ASR 推理引擎。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs (bitnet.cpp), efficiently running ternary-quantized models on CPUs and GPUs, along with companion 1-bit embedding models and an ASR inference engine.

projects.name: tinyhumansai/openhuman
projects.summary: Rust 内核的开源 Agent Harness，号称最快最省的个人 AI 方案，可插拔任意 LLM/记忆/搜索引擎，桌面应用主打隐私本地优先，上线一周内连续 9 天登上 GitHub Trending。
projects.summary_en: Open-source agent harness with a Rust core, billed as the fastest and leanest personal-AI option, with pluggable LLMs, memory, and search engines. The desktop app is privacy-first and local-first; it hit GitHub Trending for nine days in a row within a week of launch.

projects.name: datalab-to/marker
projects.summary: 把 PDF、图片、Office 与 EPUB 等文档快速转成 Markdown、JSON 和 HTML，保留表格、公式与版面，可选用 LLM 提升准确度。
projects.summary_en: Converts PDFs, images, Office files, and EPUBs into Markdown, JSON, and HTML while preserving tables, equations, and layout, with an optional LLM mode for higher accuracy.

projects.name: wshobson/agents
projects.summary: 面向 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode、GitHub Copilot、Antigravity、Pi 等多种 Harness 的插件市场，94 个插件、202 个子 Agent、184 个技能、105 个命令，一份 Markdown 源生成各 Harness 原生格式。
projects.summary_en: Plugin marketplace for multiple harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity, Pi): 94 plugins, 202 sub-agents, 184 skills, and 105 commands, with each harness's native format generated from a single Markdown source.

projects.name: google-research/bert
projects.summary: Google 发布的 BERT 官方 TensorFlow 代码与预训练模型，开启了「预训练加微调」的 NLP 范式。仓库已归档，不再更新。
projects.summary_en: Google's official TensorFlow code and pretrained models for BERT, which established the pretrain-then-fine-tune paradigm in NLP. The repository is archived.

projects.name: HKUDS/LightRAG
projects.summary: 简单快速的检索增强生成系统（EMNLP2025），支持多种文本分块策略、角色化 LLM 配置，并已合并多模态解析能力（MinerU/Docling），可对接 OpenSearch 等存储后端。
projects.summary_en: Simple and fast retrieval-augmented generation system (EMNLP 2025) with multiple chunking strategies and role-based LLM configuration. Has merged multimodal parsing (MinerU/Docling) and can use storage backends such as OpenSearch.

projects.name: 2noise/ChatTTS
projects.summary: 面向日常对话场景的生成式语音模型，支持中英文、笑声与停顿等韵律控制；开源版本主要是算法与示例代码。
projects.summary_en: A generative speech model for everyday dialogue, supporting Chinese and English with prosody control such as laughter and pauses; the open release mainly contains algorithm code and examples.

projects.name: mindsdb/mindshub
projects.summary: 开源 Agent 工作空间（原 Minds），可自由选择模型和供应商完成知识工作与软件开发，提供桌面/Web 客户端和统一推理 API，避免被单一模型生态锁定。
projects.summary_en: Open-source agent workspace (formerly Minds) for knowledge work and software development with the model and provider of your choice. Offers desktop and web clients plus a unified inference API to avoid lock-in to any single model ecosystem.

projects.name: shiyu-coder/Kronos
projects.summary: 面向金融市场 K 线的开源基础模型，在来自全球多个交易所的数据上预训练，可用于预测等下游任务。
projects.summary_en: An open-source foundation model for financial candlestick (K-line) data, pretrained on data from exchanges around the world and usable for forecasting and other downstream tasks.

projects.name: lfnovo/open-notebook
projects.summary: 开源版 Notebook LM，私有、多模型、可 100% 本地部署，支持 18+ 模型供应商、PDF/音视频/网页等多模态内容整理、AI 播客生成和全文向量搜索。
projects.summary_en: Open-source take on NotebookLM: private, multi-model, and 100% locally deployable. Supports 18+ model providers, multimodal content such as PDFs, audio/video, and web pages, AI podcast generation, and full-text vector search.

projects.name: THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC
projects.summary: 清华大学出品的开放多智能体互动课堂，一键生成沉浸式多智能体学习体验，v1.0 新增 Agent Workbench，可从上传的资料自主规划课程、逐页构建并持续修订。
projects.summary_en: Tsinghua University's open multi-agent interactive classroom: generate an immersive multi-agent learning experience in one click. v1.0 adds an Agent Workbench that plans a course from uploaded material, builds it page by page, and keeps revising it.

projects.name: The-Vibe-Company/quivr
projects.summary: 带主见的 RAG 组件，几行代码即可给产品接入检索增强生成能力，支持任意 LLM（GPT4/Groq/Llama）和任意向量库（PGVector/Faiss），配套 Megaparse 文件解析。
projects.summary_en: Opinionated RAG component: add retrieval-augmented generation to a product in a few lines of code. Works with any LLM (GPT-4, Groq, Llama) and any vector store (PGVector, Faiss), with Megaparse for file parsing.

projects.name: floodsung/Deep-Learning-Papers-Reading-Roadmap
projects.summary: 给深度学习新人的论文阅读路线图，按主题与难度排列经典论文并附链接。
projects.summary_en: A reading roadmap of deep learning papers for newcomers, ordering classic papers by topic and difficulty with links.

projects.name: lm-sys/FastChat
projects.summary: LMSYS 出品的大模型训练/服务/评测开放平台，驱动着 Chatbot Arena（lmarena.ai）积累了超百万人类对战投票，也是 Vicuna 模型的发布仓库。
projects.summary_en: LMSYS's open platform for training, serving, and evaluating LLMs. Powers Chatbot Arena (lmarena.ai), which has collected over a million human battle votes, and is the release repo for the Vicuna model.

projects.name: github/awesome-copilot
projects.summary: GitHub 官方维护的 Copilot 定制资源合集，收录社区贡献的自定义 Agent、指令、技能、Hook 和插件，配套可搜索的网站和面向 Agent 的 llms.txt。
projects.summary_en: GitHub-maintained collection of Copilot customization resources: community-contributed custom agents, instructions, skills, hooks, and plugins, with a searchable site and an agent-facing llms.txt.

projects.name: Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-claudecode
projects.summary: 面向团队的 Claude Code 多智能体编排工具，零学习曲线上手并行执行任务，同系列还有面向 Codex 的 oh-my-codex。
projects.summary_en: Multi-agent orchestration tool for Claude Code aimed at teams, with zero learning curve for running tasks in parallel. The same family includes oh-my-codex for Codex.

projects.name: deepseek-ai/awesome-deepseek-integration
projects.summary: DeepSeek 官方维护的第三方集成合集，收录把 DeepSeek API 接入各类主流软件（IM 插件、浏览器扩展、IDE 插件等）的方案列表。
projects.summary_en: DeepSeek-maintained list of third-party integrations that plug the DeepSeek API into popular software (IM plugins, browser extensions, IDE plugins, and more).

projects.name: suno-ai/bark
projects.summary: Suno 的文本提示生成式音频模型，可合成多语种语音，并能生成笑声、叹气等非语言声音和简单音乐。
projects.summary_en: Suno's text-prompted generative audio model that synthesizes multilingual speech along with non-verbal sounds such as laughter and sighs, and simple music.

projects.name: bytedance/UI-TARS-desktop
projects.summary: 字节跳动开源的多模态 AI Agent 技术栈，包含 Agent TARS（通用多模态 Agent CLI/Web UI）与 UI-TARS-desktop（基于 UI-TARS 模型的桌面 GUI Agent），支持浏览器与电脑操作。
projects.summary_en: ByteDance's open-source multimodal AI agent stack: Agent TARS (a general multimodal agent CLI/web UI) and UI-TARS-desktop (a desktop GUI agent built on the UI-TARS model), supporting browser and computer operation.

projects.name: volcengine/OpenViking
projects.summary: 字节跳动火山引擎开源的 AI Agent 上下文数据库，把知识、记忆、技能统一组织成可浏览、可编辑的 viking:// 虚拟文件系统，替代“黑盒”式向量记忆。
projects.summary_en: ByteDance's Volcano Engine open-source context database for AI agents: organizes knowledge, memory, and skills into a browsable, editable viking:// virtual filesystem, replacing "black-box" vector memory.

projects.name: zhaoxuya520/reverse-skill
projects.summary: 面向逆向工程/授权渗透测试/安全研究的技能路由包，AI 根据任务自动路由到对应方法论、按需自举工具链并积累经验库，支持 Claude Code、Kiro、Cursor、Cline 等客户端。
projects.summary_en: Skill-routing pack for reverse engineering, authorized penetration testing, and security research: the AI routes each task to the matching methodology, bootstraps toolchains on demand, and accumulates an experience library. Supports Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline, and other clients.

projects.name: google/langextract
projects.summary: Google 官方 Python 库，用 LLM 从非结构化文本中抽取结构化信息并做精确的原文溯源和交互式可视化，支持 Gemini 和本地 Ollama 模型。
projects.summary_en: Google's official Python library that uses LLMs to extract structured information from unstructured text, with precise source grounding and interactive visualization. Supports Gemini and local Ollama models.

projects.name: naptha/tesseract.js
projects.summary: Tesseract OCR 的纯 JavaScript / WebAssembly 版本，可在浏览器和 Node.js 中识别 100 多种语言。
projects.summary_en: A pure JavaScript and WebAssembly build of Tesseract OCR that recognizes over 100 languages in the browser and in Node.js.

projects.name: chatchat-space/Langchain-Chatchat
projects.summary: 基于 LangChain 与 ChatGLM/Qwen/Llama 等模型实现的本地知识库 RAG 与 Agent 应用，支持离线私有部署，可用 Xinference/Ollama 等框架接入开源模型。
projects.summary_en: Local knowledge-base RAG and agent application built on LangChain and models such as ChatGLM, Qwen, and Llama. Supports offline private deployment and connects open-source models through frameworks like Xinference and Ollama.

projects.name: RVC-Project/Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-WebUI
projects.summary: 基于检索的语音音色转换框架，用不到十分钟的语音数据即可训练变声模型，带完整的 WebUI 训练与推理流程。
projects.summary_en: A retrieval-based voice conversion framework that trains a voice-changing model from under ten minutes of audio, with a full WebUI for training and inference.

projects.name: JustVugg/colibri
projects.summary: 用纯 C 编写、零依赖的推理引擎，通过把专家权重从存储流式载入，让消费级硬件也能运行数百亿至数万亿参数的 MoE 模型。
projects.summary_en: A zero-dependency pure-C inference engine that streams expert weights from storage so consumer hardware can run mixture-of-experts models with hundreds of billions to trillions of parameters.

projects.name: stanfordnlp/dspy
projects.summary: 斯坦福 NLP 实验室出品的框架，主张“编程而非提示”语言模型——用可组合的模块和优化器代替手写 prompt 字符串来构建和调优 LLM 应用。
projects.summary_en: Framework from the Stanford NLP Lab that argues for "programming, not prompting" language models: composable modules and optimizers replace hand-written prompt strings for building and tuning LLM apps.

projects.name: anthropics/prompt-eng-interactive-tutorial
projects.summary: Anthropic 官方交互式提示工程教程，9 章配练习，教你从基础提示结构到复杂场景（法律、客服等）系统掌握 Claude 提示技巧。
projects.summary_en: Anthropic's official interactive prompt-engineering tutorial: 9 chapters with exercises that take you from basic prompt structure to complex scenarios such as legal and customer service, systematically building Claude prompting skills.

projects.name: anthropics/financial-services
projects.summary: Anthropic 官方面向投行、股票研究、私募、财富管理等金融场景的参考 Agent、技能与数据连接器合集，可作 Claude Cowork 插件或通过 Managed Agents API 部署，所有产出均需人工签字确认。
projects.summary_en: Anthropic's official set of reference agents, skills, and data connectors for investment banking, equity research, private equity, wealth management, and other financial scenarios. Deployable as a Claude Cowork plugin or through the Managed Agents API; all outputs require human sign-off.

projects.name: OpenBMB/VoxCPM
projects.summary: OpenBMB 的无分词器语音合成模型，支持多语种合成、根据文字描述设计音色和高保真声音克隆。
projects.summary_en: OpenBMB's tokenizer-free speech synthesis model, with multilingual generation, voice design from text descriptions, and high-fidelity voice cloning.

projects.name: ashishpatel26/500-AI-Agents-Projects
projects.summary: 按行业整理的 AI Agent 用例与项目合集，附框架说明与实现链接。
projects.summary_en: A curated collection of AI agent use cases and projects organized by industry, with framework notes and links to implementations.

projects.name: patchy631/ai-engineering-hub
projects.summary: 面向 AI 工程的教程集合，包含 LLM、RAG 与真实 Agent 应用的实战示例，以 Jupyter Notebook 为主。
projects.summary_en: A collection of AI engineering tutorials with hands-on examples of LLMs, RAG, and real-world agent applications, mostly as Jupyter notebooks.

projects.name: fengdu78/Coursera-ML-AndrewNg-Notes
projects.summary: 斯坦福（吴恩达）机器学习课程的中文个人笔记，可在线阅读。
projects.summary_en: Personal Chinese notes on Andrew Ng's Stanford machine learning course, available to read online.

projects.name: VectifyAI/PageIndex
projects.summary: 无向量数据库的推理式 RAG，把文档索引成层级树结构，让 LLM 像人类专家一样逐层“推理检索”而非单纯语义相似度匹配，专为长篇专业文档设计。
projects.summary_en: Vectorless, reasoning-based RAG: indexes documents into a hierarchical tree so an LLM can "reason its way through retrieval" layer by layer like a human expert instead of relying on semantic similarity alone. Built for long professional documents.

projects.name: myshell-ai/OpenVoice
projects.summary: MIT 与 MyShell 发布的即时声音克隆模型，可精确复制参考音色并控制情感、口音与节奏，支持跨语种合成。
projects.summary_en: An instant voice cloning model from MIT and MyShell that reproduces a reference tone color with control over emotion, accent, and rhythm, including cross-lingual synthesis.

projects.name: microsoft/playwright-mcp
projects.summary: 微软的 Playwright MCP 服务器，通过页面可访问性快照让 LLM 以结构化方式操作网页，无需依赖截图。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's Playwright MCP server that lets LLMs drive web pages through structured accessibility snapshots instead of screenshots.

projects.name: TencentARC/GFPGAN
projects.summary: 腾讯 ARC 实验室的真实场景人脸修复算法，利用预训练人脸生成先验恢复老照片和低质量人像。
projects.summary_en: Tencent ARC Lab's blind face restoration algorithm that uses a pretrained face generative prior to restore old photos and low-quality portraits.

projects.name: exacity/deeplearningbook-chinese
projects.summary: 《Deep Learning》（花书）的中文翻译，由社区协作翻译与校对，以 LaTeX 维护。
projects.summary_en: A community-made Chinese translation of the Deep Learning textbook by Goodfellow, Bengio, and Courville, maintained in LaTeX.

projects.name: CopilotKit/CopilotKit
projects.summary: Agent 原生应用的前端技术栈，为 React/Angular/Vue/React Native 及 Slack/Teams 提供生成式 UI、共享状态和人机协同工作流，AG-UI 协议的提出方。
projects.summary_en: Frontend stack for agent-native apps: generative UI, shared state, and human-in-the-loop workflows for React, Angular, Vue, React Native, Slack, and Teams. Originator of the AG-UI protocol.

projects.name: khoj-ai/khoj
projects.summary: 自托管的个人 AI 第二大脑，可对接任意本地或在线 LLM，从网络和本地文档中检索答案、创建自定义知识 Agent、定时自动化深度研究，支持浏览器/Obsidian/Emacs/手机/WhatsApp 多入口。
projects.summary_en: Self-hosted personal AI "second brain" that works with any local or online LLM, answers from the web and your documents, builds custom knowledge agents, and schedules automated deep research. Reachable from browser, Obsidian, Emacs, phone, and WhatsApp.

projects.name: musistudio/claude-code-router
projects.summary: 本地控制面板，把 Claude Code、Codex、Grok CLI、Kimi CLI 等编码 Agent 与任意模型供应商连接起来，统一路由、故障转移、扩展能力并观测每一次请求。
projects.summary_en: Local control panel that connects coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Grok CLI, and Kimi CLI to any model provider, with unified routing, failover, extensibility, and observability of every request.

projects.name: karpathy/LLM101n
projects.summary: Andrej Karpathy 发起的教学项目，计划从零手把手（Python/C/CUDA）教你搭建一个类 ChatGPT 的故事生成 LLM，目前该课程仍在由 Eureka Labs 开发中，仓库处于归档状态。
projects.summary_en: Andrej Karpathy's teaching project that plans to walk you through building a ChatGPT-like story-generating LLM from scratch (Python/C/CUDA). The course is still in development at Eureka Labs and the repo is archived.

projects.name: microsoft/Data-Science-For-Beginners
projects.summary: 微软的 10 周、20 课时数据科学入门课程，每课含课前课后测验。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's 10-week, 20-lesson introduction to data science, with pre- and post-lesson quizzes in every lesson.

projects.name: LAION-AI/Open-Assistant
projects.summary: LAION 发起的开源聊天助手项目，目标是让所有人都能用上高质量对话式大模型，项目已于 2023 年完结，产出的 oasst2 数据集仍在 HuggingFace 开放。
projects.summary_en: LAION's open-source chat-assistant project, aiming to give everyone access to a high-quality conversational LLM. Concluded in 2023; its oasst2 dataset remains open on HuggingFace.

projects.name: AlexsJones/llmfit
projects.summary: 命令行硬件适配工具，检测你的 CPU/内存/GPU/显存配置，推荐能在本机流畅跑的开源 LLM 及量化方案，并可把实测 token/s 提交回项目共享给其他人参考。
projects.summary_en: Command-line hardware-fit tool that detects your CPU, RAM, GPU, and VRAM, recommends open-source LLMs and quantizations that run smoothly on your machine, and lets you submit measured tokens/s back to share with others.

projects.name: PDFMathTranslate/PDFMathTranslate
projects.summary: 保留排版的科学 PDF 双语翻译工具（EMNLP 2025 Demo），支持公式、图表、目录、批注完整保留，提供 CLI/GUI/MCP/Docker/Zotero 多种接入方式，对接 Google/DeepL/Ollama/OpenAI 等翻译服务。
projects.summary_en: Layout-preserving bilingual translation for scientific PDFs (EMNLP 2025 demo), keeping formulas, figures, tables of contents, and annotations intact. Offers CLI, GUI, MCP, Docker, and Zotero access, and connects to translation services such as Google, DeepL, Ollama, and OpenAI.

projects.name: openai/gym
projects.summary: 经典的强化学习环境接口与基准集合。维护团队已将后续开发转到 Gymnasium，Gym 不再更新，仓库已归档。
projects.summary_en: The classic interface and benchmark suite for reinforcement learning environments. Development has moved to Gymnasium and this repository is archived.

projects.name: anthropics/claude-plugins-official

projects.summary_en: Anthropic-maintained directory of Claude Code plugins, including first-party plugins and vetted third-party ones, installable in one step with /plugin install.

projects.name: huggingface/pytorch-image-models
projects.summary: timm：最大的 PyTorch 图像骨干网络与预训练权重集合，附训练、验证与推理脚本。
projects.summary_en: timm, the largest collection of PyTorch image encoders and pretrained weights, with training, validation, and inference scripts.

projects.name: google-ai-edge/mediapipe
projects.summary: Google 的跨平台端侧机器学习方案，提供手部、人脸、姿态等实时感知的现成管线，也支持自定义模型与端侧生成式 AI。
projects.summary_en: Google's cross-platform on-device ML solutions, offering ready-made real-time pipelines for hands, faces, and pose, with support for custom models and on-device generative AI.

projects.name: songquanpeng/one-api
projects.summary: LLM API 统一管理与分发系统，支持 OpenAI/Azure/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek/文心一言/通义千问等主流模型，单可执行文件、Docker 一键部署，用于 key 管理和二次分发。
projects.summary_en: Unified LLM API management and distribution system supporting OpenAI, Azure, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, ERNIE Bot, Tongyi Qianwen, and other mainstream models. A single executable with one-step Docker deployment, used for key management and secondary distribution.

projects.name: ashishpatel26/500-AI-Machine-learning-Deep-learning-Computer-vision-NLP-Projects-with-code
projects.summary: 500 多个带代码的 AI、机器学习、深度学习、计算机视觉与 NLP 项目清单。
projects.summary_en: A list of more than 500 AI, machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, and NLP projects with code.

projects.name: xinntao/Real-ESRGAN
projects.summary: 面向真实场景的通用图像与视频超分修复算法，提供针对动漫图像和动漫视频的专用小模型。
projects.summary_en: A practical algorithm for general image and video super-resolution and restoration, with dedicated smaller models for anime images and anime video.

projects.name: ItzCrazyKns/Vane
projects.summary: 隐私优先、完全自托管的 AI 问答搜索引擎（原 Perplexica），支持本地 Ollama 与 OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/Groq 等云端模型，基于 SearxNG 聚合多搜索引擎并标注信息来源。
projects.summary_en: Privacy-first, fully self-hosted AI answer engine (formerly Perplexica). Supports local Ollama and cloud models such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and Groq, and aggregates multiple search engines through SearxNG with cited sources.

projects.name: babysor/MockingBird
projects.summary: 以中文为主的实时声音克隆项目，几秒参考音频即可合成任意文本。作者已表示不再积极更新。
projects.summary_en: A Chinese-focused real-time voice cloning project that synthesizes arbitrary text from a few seconds of reference audio. The author says it is no longer actively updated.

projects.name: sgl-project/sglang
projects.summary: 高性能 LLM/多模态模型推理服务框架，Day-0 支持 DeepSeek-V4/Kimi K3 等最新开源模型，在 NVIDIA GB300 等新硬件上做推理性能优化。
projects.summary_en: High-performance serving framework for LLMs and multimodal models, with day-0 support for the latest open models such as DeepSeek-V4 and Kimi K3 and inference optimization on new hardware such as NVIDIA GB300.

projects.name: gitroomhq/postiz-app
projects.summary: 开源社媒排期与自动化工具，可通过 ChatGPT/Claude/Claude Code/Codex/Cursor 等 AI Agent 直接驱动发布，提供 Node SDK 和 n8n/Make.com 集成。
projects.summary_en: Open-source social-media scheduling and automation tool that AI agents such as ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor can drive directly. Offers a Node SDK and n8n/Make.com integrations.

projects.name: hankcs/HanLP
projects.summary: 多语种自然语言处理工具包，基于 PyTorch 与 TensorFlow 2，提供分词、词性标注、依存句法、命名实体识别等十余种联合任务。
projects.summary_en: A multilingual NLP toolkit on PyTorch and TensorFlow 2 that supports joint tasks including tokenization, part-of-speech tagging, dependency parsing, and named entity recognition across many languages.

projects.name: jax-ml/jax
projects.summary: 可组合的 Python + NumPy 程序变换库，提供自动微分、向量化和即时编译，可在 GPU / TPU 上高性能运行，是许多大模型训练栈的基础。
projects.summary_en: A library of composable transformations for Python and NumPy programs: autodiff, vectorization, and JIT compilation for GPUs and TPUs, and a foundation of many large-model training stacks.

projects.name: reworkd/AgentGPT
projects.summary: 早期知名的浏览器端自主 Agent 项目，输入一个目标即可配置、部署自主 AI Agent，自动拆解任务、执行并从结果中学习。
projects.summary_en: Early well-known in-browser autonomous agent: enter a goal to configure and deploy an autonomous AI agent that breaks down tasks, executes them, and learns from the results.

projects.name: microsoft/graphrag
projects.summary: Microsoft 官方出品的模块化图谱式检索增强生成系统，通过构建知识图谱提升复杂问答场景下的检索质量。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's modular graph-based retrieval-augmented generation system, building a knowledge graph to improve retrieval quality for complex question answering.

projects.name: DayuanJiang/next-ai-draw-io
projects.summary: 把 AI 与 draw.io 结合的 Next.js 网页应用，通过对话创建、修改和优化图表。
projects.summary_en: A Next.js web application that integrates AI with draw.io, creating, modifying, and improving diagrams through chat.

projects.name: continuedev/continue
projects.summary: 开源编码 Agent，可接入 IDE 或终端，支持自定义模型和规则，帮助开发者在保留控制权的前提下把 AI 编码能力集成进现有工作流。
projects.summary_en: Open-source coding agent for IDEs and the terminal, with custom models and rules, helping developers bring AI coding into existing workflows while keeping control.

projects.name: linshenkx/prompt-optimizer
projects.summary: AI 提示词优化工具，支持网页、桌面、Chrome 插件、Docker 四种形态，把手写/模板/本地导入的提示词进行优化、测试、评估并沉淀为可复用资产。
projects.summary_en: AI prompt-optimization tool available as a web app, desktop app, Chrome extension, and Docker image. Optimizes, tests, and evaluates handwritten, templated, or imported prompts and saves them as reusable assets.

projects.name: XingangPan/DragGAN
projects.summary: SIGGRAPH 2023 论文 DragGAN 的官方代码，允许在生成图像上拖动控制点来交互式编辑物体姿态和形状。
projects.summary_en: The official code for the SIGGRAPH 2023 paper DragGAN, which lets users drag control points on a generated image to interactively edit object pose and shape.

projects.name: esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix
projects.summary: 面向终端的 DeepSeek 原生编码 Agent，围绕 prefix-cache 稳定性设计、可长时间挂机运行，单一 Go 二进制，支持终端/桌面/浏览器/编辑器（ACP）四种接入方式。
projects.summary_en: DeepSeek-native coding agent for the terminal, designed around prefix-cache stability and long unattended runs. A single Go binary with four access modes: terminal, desktop, browser, and editor (ACP).

projects.name: lightpanda-io/browser
projects.summary: 从零用 Zig 写的专为 AI Agent 和自动化设计的无头浏览器，非 Chromium/WebKit 分支，内存占用降到 Chromium 的 1/16、速度快 9 倍。
projects.summary_en: Headless browser written from scratch in Zig for AI agents and automation. Not a Chromium/WebKit fork; uses 1/16 of Chromium's memory and runs 9x faster.

projects.name: JCodesMore/ai-website-cloner-template
projects.summary: 网站克隆模板：给 AI 编码 Agent 一个网址，让它一键重建成 Next.js 应用，配合 Claude Code 等使用。
projects.summary_en: A website-cloning template: give an AI coding agent a URL and it recreates the site as a Next.js app, designed to work with agents such as Claude Code.

projects.name: agentscope-ai/QwenPaw
projects.summary: 个人 AI 助理，易于本地或云端部署，三层记忆架构（工作上下文/完整历史/自进化知识库）、内置沙箱与工具/文件安全防护，支持多 Agent 并行与跨系统通信协议 ACP。
projects.summary_en: Personal AI assistant that is easy to deploy locally or in the cloud. Three-tier memory (working context, full history, self-evolving knowledge base), built-in sandbox and tool/file safeguards, parallel multi-agent execution, and the ACP cross-system communication protocol.

projects.name: lyogavin/airllm
projects.summary: 极致显存优化的大模型推理库，通过分层流式加载让 70B 模型在 4GB 显卡上跑起来，支持 Kimi K3（2.8T 参数）、DeepSeek-V3 等超大模型的单卡推理与训练。
projects.summary_en: Extreme memory-optimized LLM inference library: layer-by-layer streaming lets a 70B model run on a 4GB GPU. Supports single-GPU inference and training of very large models such as Kimi K3 (2.8T parameters) and DeepSeek-V3.

projects.name: langfuse/langfuse
projects.summary: 开源 LLM 应用可观测性与评测平台，追踪、评估、改进 AI 应用的一站式工具，可分钟级自托管，被 ClickHouse 收购后持续商业化运营。
projects.summary_en: Open-source LLM application observability and evaluation platform: one place to trace, evaluate, and improve AI apps, self-hostable in minutes. Continues to operate commercially after being acquired by ClickHouse.

projects.name: fxsjy/jieba
projects.summary: 广泛使用的中文分词 Python 组件，提供精确、全、搜索引擎和 paddle 四种分词模式，并支持自定义词典与关键词提取。
projects.summary_en: A widely used Python component for Chinese word segmentation, with precise, full, search-engine, and paddle modes, custom dictionaries, and keyword extraction.

projects.name: VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills
projects.summary: 精选（非 AI 批量生成）的官方团队 Agent Skills 合集，收录 Claude、VoltAgent、Supabase、Stripe、Google Gemini 等团队发布的真实技能，兼容 Claude Code/Codex/Cursor/Gemini CLI 等。
projects.summary_en: Curated (not AI-bulk-generated) collection of Agent Skills from official teams, including real skills published by Claude, VoltAgent, Supabase, Stripe, Google Gemini, and others. Compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more.

projects.name: qdrant/qdrant
projects.summary: Rust 编写的高性能向量数据库与搜索引擎，支持混合检索、多租户过滤，并提供官方 Agent Skills 让编码 Agent 直接做量化/分片等向量检索工程决策。
projects.summary_en: High-performance vector database and search engine written in Rust, with hybrid search and multi-tenant filtering, and official Agent Skills that let coding agents make vector-search engineering decisions such as quantization and sharding.

projects.name: facebookresearch/detectron2
projects.summary: Meta AI 基于 PyTorch 的目标检测与分割平台，是 Detectron 的重写版，提供 Mask R-CNN 等大量算法和模型库。
projects.summary_en: Meta AI's PyTorch platform for object detection and segmentation, a ground-up rewrite of Detectron with Mask R-CNN and many other algorithms and a model zoo.

projects.name: huggingface/diffusers
projects.summary: Hugging Face 的扩散模型库，提供预训练管线、可替换的噪声调度器和模型组件，覆盖图像、视频与音频生成，并支持训练与微调。
projects.summary_en: Hugging Face's diffusion model library, with pretrained pipelines, interchangeable noise schedulers, and model building blocks for image, video, and audio generation, plus training and fine-tuning support.

projects.name: BVLC/caffe
projects.summary: 伯克利 AI 研究组与社区开发的 C++ 深度学习框架，以表达力、速度和模块化为目标，曾是早期计算机视觉研究的主流框架。
projects.summary_en: A C++ deep learning framework from Berkeley AI Research and community contributors, designed for expressiveness, speed, and modularity, and once the mainstream framework for early computer vision research.

projects.name: Leey21/awesome-ai-research-writing
projects.summary: 面向学术论文写作的提示词与 Agent 技能模板库，用于润色、改写等环节。
projects.summary_en: A library of prompts and agent-skill templates for academic paper writing, covering polishing, rewriting, and related steps.

projects.name: CMU-Perceptual-Computing-Lab/openpose
projects.summary: 首个可实时检测多人身体、手部、面部和脚部关键点的开源库，提供 C++ 与 Python 接口。
projects.summary_en: The first open-source library to detect body, hand, face, and foot keypoints for multiple people in real time, with C++ and Python interfaces.

projects.name: OpenBMB/ChatDev

projects.summary_en: ChatDev 2.0: simulates a virtual software company (CEO, CTO, programmers, testers, and other roles) through LLM-driven multi-agent collaboration to complete the whole software-development process.

projects.name: openai/CLIP

projects.summary_en: OpenAI's contrastive language-image pretraining model, which maps images and text into one space and scores their relevance zero-shot; a key building block for multimodal models.

projects.name: HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
projects.summary: 个人交易 Agent，一条命令即可为 Agent 装备完整的量化交易能力，支持回测、多 Agent 协作和 MCP 接入。
projects.summary_en: Personal trading agent: one command equips an agent with full quantitative-trading capabilities, including backtesting, multi-agent collaboration, and MCP access.

projects.name: datawhalechina/happy-llm

projects.summary_en: Systematic LLM tutorial from Datawhale: from NLP basics through hand-building LLaMA2, pre-training, SFT, and LoRA fine-tuning, all the way to agentic RL (GRPO, Search-R1, ReTool).

projects.name: lllyasviel/ControlNet

projects.summary_en: A neural network architecture that adds conditional controls such as edges, depth, and pose to text-to-image diffusion models, constraining generation to a reference structure.

projects.name: google-research/timesfm
projects.summary: Google Research 的时间序列基础模型，采用纯解码器结构预训练，用于零样本时序预测。
projects.summary_en: Google Research's time-series foundation model, a decoder-only architecture pretrained for zero-shot forecasting.

projects.name: chenfei-wu/TaskMatrix
projects.summary: TaskMatrix（Visual ChatGPT）：把 ChatGPT 与一系列视觉基础模型连接起来，使对话中可以收发图像并做绘图与编辑。
projects.summary_en: TaskMatrix (Visual ChatGPT): connects ChatGPT with a series of visual foundation models so that images can be sent, received, drawn, and edited during a conversation.

projects.name: SillyTavern/SillyTavern
projects.summary: 面向重度玩家的本地 LLM 前端，统一对接 KoboldAI/NovelAI/OpenAI/Claude 等几乎所有文本生成后端，支持视觉小说模式、图像生成、TTS、World Info 角色设定和海量第三方扩展。
projects.summary_en: Local LLM front end for power users, connecting to nearly every text-generation backend (KoboldAI, NovelAI, OpenAI, Claude, and more), with visual-novel mode, image generation, TTS, World Info character setups, and a huge library of third-party extensions.

projects.name: explosion/spaCy
projects.summary: 面向生产环境的工业级 NLP 库，提供分词、词性标注、命名实体识别、依存分析和可训练的预训练流水线。
projects.summary_en: An industrial-strength NLP library for production use, with tokenization, tagging, named entity recognition, dependency parsing, and trainable pretrained pipelines.

projects.name: mli/paper-reading
projects.summary: 李沐的深度学习论文精读视频与笔记清单，逐段讲解经典与新论文，包括 Llama 3.1、Sora 等。
projects.summary_en: Mu Li's video walkthroughs of deep learning papers, reading classic and new papers section by section, including Llama 3.1 and Sora.

projects.name: TabbyML/tabby

projects.summary_en: Self-hosted AI coding assistant, an open-source local alternative to GitHub Copilot. Self-contained with no database or cloud service needed, runs on consumer GPUs, and is incubating a private-beta agent, Pochi.

projects.name: can1357/oh-my-pi
projects.summary: Stencil Labs 出品、fork 自 Pi 的编码 Agent，深度集成 IDE 能力，支持 60+ 模型供应商、31 种内置工具、14 种 LSP 操作，核心用 Rust 实现。
projects.summary_en: Coding agent from Stencil Labs, forked from Pi, with deep IDE integration, 60+ model providers, 31 built-in tools, and 14 LSP operations. Core implemented in Rust.

projects.name: freestylefly/awesome-gpt-image-2
projects.summary: GPT Image 2 / 2.5 的提示词与案例库，含 500 多个案例和 20 多套可复用模板与技能。
projects.summary_en: A prompt and case library for GPT Image 2 and 2.5, with more than 500 cases and 20-plus reusable templates and skills.

projects.name: openai/codex-plugin-cc
projects.summary: OpenAI 官方出品的 Claude Code 插件，让你在 Claude Code 里直接调用 Codex 做代码评审或委派任务，提供 /codex:review 等命令，需要 ChatGPT 订阅或 OpenAI API Key。
projects.summary_en: OpenAI's Claude Code plugin that lets you call Codex from inside Claude Code for code review or delegated tasks, with commands such as /codex:review. Requires a ChatGPT subscription or an OpenAI API key.

projects.name: tinygrad/tinygrad

projects.summary_en: A minimalist deep learning stack between PyTorch and micrograd, with an autodiff tensor library, a kernel-fusing compiler, and many hardware backends.

projects.name: Pythagora-io/gpt-pilot
projects.summary: 早期知名的“AI 全自动开发者”项目，能从需求描述自主写代码；⚠️ 仓库 2025-08~2026-06 期间曾被植入窃取凭据的供应链蠕虫恶意代码，已于 2026-06-11 清除，若在此期间克隆并运行过需立即轮换凭据。

projects.name: mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills
projects.summary: 面向 AI Agent 的网络安全技能库，818 个技能覆盖 34 个安全领域，映射 MITRE ATT&CK/NIST CSF 等 6 大框架，社区项目，与 Anthropic 官方无关联，仅限授权测试使用。
projects.summary_en: Cybersecurity skill library for AI agents: 818 skills across 34 security domains, mapped to six frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF. A community project unaffiliated with Anthropic, for authorized testing only.

projects.name: Twigpine/openclaude
projects.summary: 开源编码 Agent 命令行工具，一套终端工作流对接 OpenAI 兼容 API、Gemini、GitHub Models、Ollama 等云端与本地模型，支持工具、MCP 与斜杠命令。
projects.summary_en: An open-source coding-agent CLI with one terminal workflow across OpenAI-compatible APIs, Gemini, GitHub Models, Ollama, and other cloud and local backends, supporting tools, MCP, and slash commands.

projects.name: lutzroeder/netron
